source_text_zh: 【国家发改委主任郑栅洁：坚定实施扩大内需战略】国家发改委主任郑栅洁在《学习时报》发表文章指出，坚定实施扩大内需战略。要更好统筹扩大内需和深化供给侧结构性改革，增强国内大循环动力和可靠性。充分发挥消费对经济增长的基础性作用。多渠道增加城乡居民收入，稳定汽车等大宗消费，推动新能源汽车下乡，培育壮大绿色消费、服务消费等消费新热点。进一步增强投资对优化供给结构的关键作用。加快实施“十四五”规划102项重大工程及其他经济社会重大项目建设，推动能源、水利、交通等重大基础设施及新型基础设施建设，发挥政府投资和政策激励的引导作用，有效激发民间投资活力。
display_text_en: [NDRC Chairman Zheng Shanjie: Firmly Implement the Strategy of Expanding Domestic Demand] NDRC Chairman Zheng Shanjie wrote in an article published in Study Times that the strategy of expanding domestic demand should be firmly implemented. The expansion of domestic demand should be better coordinated with deepening supply-side structural reform to strengthen the momentum and reliability of the domestic economic cycle. The fundamental role of consumption in economic growth should be fully leveraged. Urban and rural residents' incomes should be increased through multiple channels, consumption of major items such as automobiles should be stabilised, new-energy vehicles should be promoted in rural areas, and new growth areas in consumption, including green consumption and service consumption, should be fostered and expanded. The key role of investment in optimising the supply structure should be further strengthened. Implementation of the 102 major projects under the 14th Five-Year Plan and other major economic and social projects should be accelerated; major infrastructure and new infrastructure construction in areas including energy, water conservancy and transport should be advanced; the guiding role of government investment and policy incentives should be leveraged; and the vitality of private investment should be effectively stimulated.

source_text_zh: 中国央行于6月15日进行2370亿元的一年期MLF操作，利率从2.75%降至2.65%。当天有2000亿元的MLF到期。
display_text_en: On June 15, the People's Bank of China conducted RMB 237 billion of one-year medium-term lending facility (MLF) operations, with the interest rate lowered from 2.75% to 2.65%. RMB 200 billion of MLF funds matured on the same day.

source_text_zh: 国务院办公厅近日印发《指导意见》，计划到2030年基本建成高质量充电基础设施体系，以解决新能源汽车发展中的“充电焦虑”问题。该意见强调要补齐城乡充电基础设施短板，建设便捷的城际和城市群充电网络，并积极推进居住区的充电设施建设。同时，鼓励各类社会资本参与投资，提高运营服务水平，推动技术研究与商业合作。为支持政策落实，《指导意见》还提出优化电价政策、减免租金、提供资金支持等措施，以促进新能源汽车产业发展，实现碳达峰碳中和目标。
display_text_en: The General Office of the State Council recently issued Guiding Opinions, planning to basically establish a high-quality charging infrastructure system by 2030 in order to address the problem of "charging anxiety" in the development of new-energy vehicles. The document emphasises addressing shortcomings in urban and rural charging infrastructure, building convenient intercity and urban-cluster charging networks, and actively advancing the construction of charging facilities in residential areas. At the same time, various forms of private capital are encouraged to participate in investment, operational service standards are to be improved, and technological research and commercial cooperation are to be promoted. To support implementation of the policy, the Guiding Opinions also propose measures including optimising electricity pricing policies, reducing or waiving rents, and providing financial support, in order to promote development of the new-energy vehicle industry and achieve the goals of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality.

source_text_zh: 6月21日，财政部副部长许宏才在国务院政策例行吹风会上宣布，新能源汽车购置税减免政策将延续至2027年底。自2024年1月1日起至2025年12月31日期间，新能源汽车免征购置税，每辆车最高免税额为3万元；从2026年起到2027年，将减半征收购置税，最高减税额为1.5万元。预计该政策将在2024年至2027年间减少车辆购置税总额约5200亿元。这项政策旨在进一步推动新能源汽车的普及，并适应市场需求，其中低价车型将享受更大的减免额度。根据最新数据，新能源汽车市场渗透率持续上升，产销量显著增长。
display_text_en: On June 21, Vice Minister of Finance Xu Hongcai announced at a State Council regular policy briefing that the vehicle purchase-tax reduction and exemption policy for new-energy vehicles would be extended through the end of 2027. From January 1, 2024 to December 31, 2025, new-energy vehicles will be exempt from vehicle purchase tax, with a maximum tax exemption of RMB 30,000 per vehicle; from 2026 through 2027, vehicle purchase tax will be levied at half the normal rate, with a maximum tax reduction of RMB 15,000 per vehicle. The policy is expected to reduce vehicle purchase tax by approximately RMB 520 billion in total from 2024 to 2027. The policy is intended to further promote the adoption of new-energy vehicles and adapt to market demand, with lower-priced models receiving a greater degree of tax relief. According to the latest data, the market penetration rate of new-energy vehicles continues to rise, with production and sales increasing significantly.

source_text_zh: 6月15日，中国央行宣布将中期借贷便利（MLF）利率下调10个基点至2.65%，并进行2370亿元的1年期MLF操作，实现净投放370亿元。此次降息是为了维护银行体系流动性和刺激经济，响应近期经济回暖乏力和低通胀压力。分析师指出，随着政策利率下调，企业和居民贷款利率可能会进一步下降，特别是在房地产市场转弱背景下。此外，预计本月贷款市场报价利率（LPR）也将跟随调整，其中1年期LPR可能下调0.05个百分点，而5年期以上LPR则可能下调0.15个百分点。
display_text_en: On June 15, the People's Bank of China announced that it would lower the medium-term lending facility (MLF) rate by 10 basis points to 2.65% and conduct RMB 237 billion of one-year MLF operations, resulting in a net injection of RMB 37 billion. The rate cut was intended to maintain liquidity in the banking system and stimulate the economy in response to the recent weak economic recovery and low inflationary pressure. Analysts noted that, following the reduction in policy rates, lending rates for enterprises and households may fall further, particularly against the backdrop of a weakening property market. In addition, the loan prime rates (LPRs) are expected to be adjusted accordingly this month, with the one-year LPR potentially falling by 0.05 percentage points and the LPR for maturities of more than five years potentially falling by 0.15 percentage points.

source_text_zh: 中国人民银行授权全国银行间同业拆借中心公布，2023年6月20日贷款市场报价利率（LPR）为：1年期LPR为3.55%，此前为3.65%，5年期以上LPR为4.2%，此前为4.3%。以上LPR在下一次发布LPR之前有效。
display_text_en: The People's Bank of China authorised the National Interbank Funding Center to announce that the loan prime rates (LPRs) on June 20, 2023 were as follows: the one-year LPR was 3.55%, compared with 3.65% previously, and the LPR for maturities of more than five years was 4.2%, compared with 4.3% previously. These LPRs will remain effective until the next LPR announcement.

source_text_zh: 7月5日，卫宁健康发布公告称，公司实控人和董事长周炜因涉嫌行贿罪被茂名市监察委员会立案调查并实施留置。自7月3日以来，卫宁健康股价从10.82元跌至7.72元，跌幅达28.65%，市值蒸发66.59亿元，目前市值为165.8亿元。根据2019年公布的裁定书，周炜曾因试图影响IPO申请而向证监会前委员孙小波行贿1万欧元。
display_text_en: On July 5, Winning Health Technology Group announced that Zhou Wei, the company's actual controller and chairman, had been placed under investigation and detention by the Maoming Municipal Supervisory Commission on suspicion of bribery. Since July 3, Winning Health's share price has fallen from RMB 10.82 to RMB 7.72, a decline of 28.65%, with RMB 6.659 billion in market value erased; its current market value is RMB 16.58 billion. According to a ruling published in 2019, Zhou Wei had previously bribed Sun Xiaobo, a former member of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, with EUR 10,000 in an attempt to influence an IPO application.

source_text_zh: 【美联储宣布本次会议不加息】美联储宣布本次会议不加息，维持联邦基金利率目标区间在5%至5.25%，这是美联储自去年3月以来累计加息十次后首次暂停加息。
display_text_en: [Federal Reserve Announces No Rate Increase at This Meeting] The Federal Reserve announced that it would not raise interest rates at this meeting and would maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 5% to 5.25%. This was the first pause in rate increases since March last year, after the Federal Reserve had raised rates ten times in total.

source_text_zh: 据经参，LPR年内首次下调“如期而至”。业内人士表示，LPR下调有助于稳增长、降成本和提信心。展望未来，在全力支持实体经济之际，后续或有更多“稳增长”政策推出，货币政策将继续加大逆周期和跨周期调节力度，为宏观经济加快恢复创造更加适宜...
display_text_en: According to Economic Information Daily, the first LPR reduction of the year "arrived as expected." Industry participants said that the LPR reduction would help stabilise growth, reduce costs and boost confidence. Looking ahead, as efforts are made to fully support the real economy, more "growth-stabilising" policies may be introduced, and monetary policy will continue to strengthen counter-cyclical and cross-cyclical adjustments, creating more suitable conditions for a faster macroeconomic recovery...

source_text_zh: 财政部、税务总局和工信部于6月21日联合发布公告，决定延续新能源汽车购置税减免政策：2024年1月1日至2025年12月31日期间购置的新能源汽车免征购置税，而在2026年至2027年期间则减半征收。此次政策是对之前购置税优惠措施的第四次延期，自2014年以来该政策逐步推行以刺激市场。根据初步估算，延长政策将使得2024至2027年的减免车辆购置税规模达到5200亿元。此外，公告设定了每辆新能源乘用车的最高免税额为3万元，以及减半征收的最高额度为1.5万元，以更精准地引导市场。同时，该政策还针对换电模式进行了相关规定。此消息推动了港股新能源汽车股票上涨。
display_text_en: On June 21, the Ministry of Finance, the State Taxation Administration and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology jointly issued an announcement extending the vehicle purchase-tax reduction and exemption policy for new-energy vehicles: new-energy vehicles purchased from January 1, 2024 to December 31, 2025 will be exempt from vehicle purchase tax, while those purchased from 2026 through 2027 will be taxed at half the normal rate. This is the fourth extension of the previous vehicle purchase-tax preferential policy, which has been implemented progressively since 2014 to stimulate the market. According to preliminary estimates, the extension will bring the total scale of vehicle purchase-tax reductions and exemptions from 2024 to 2027 to RMB 520 billion. In addition, the announcement sets a maximum tax exemption of RMB 30,000 per new-energy passenger vehicle and a maximum tax reduction of RMB 15,000 for the half-rate period, in order to guide the market more precisely. The policy also includes relevant provisions for battery-swapping models. The news drove up Hong Kong-listed new-energy vehicle stocks.

source_text_zh: 【习近平主持召开中央全面深化改革委员会第二次会议强调 建设更高水平开放型经济新体制 推动能耗双控逐步转向碳排放双控】中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席、中央全面深化改革委员会主任习近平7月11日下午主持召开中央全面深化改革委员会第二次会议，审议通过了《关于建设更高水平开放型经济新体制促进构建新发展格局的意见》、《深化农村改革实施方案》、《关于推动能耗双控逐步转向碳排放双控的意见》、《关于高等学校、科研院所薪酬制度改革试点的意见》、《关于进一步深化石油天然气市场体系改革提升国家油气安全保障能力的实施意见》、《关于深化电力体制改革加快构建新型电力系统的指导意见》。（央视新闻）
display_text_en: [Xi Jinping Chairs the Second Meeting of the Central Commission for Comprehensively Deepening Reform, Emphasising the Establishment of a Higher-Standard Open-Economy System and Promoting a Gradual Shift from Dual Controls on Energy Consumption to Dual Controls on Carbon Emissions] Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, President of China, Chairman of the Central Military Commission, and Director of the Central Commission for Comprehensively Deepening Reform, chaired the second meeting of the Central Commission for Comprehensively Deepening Reform on the afternoon of July 11. The meeting reviewed and approved the Opinions on Establishing a Higher-Standard Open-Economy System to Promote the Creation of a New Development Pattern, the Implementation Plan for Deepening Rural Reform, the Opinions on Promoting a Gradual Shift from Dual Controls on Energy Consumption to Dual Controls on Carbon Emissions, the Opinions on Piloting Reform of the Remuneration System at Higher-Education Institutions and Research Institutes, the Implementation Opinions on Further Deepening Reform of the Oil and Gas Market System and Enhancing the Country's Capacity to Safeguard Oil and Gas Security, and the Guiding Opinions on Deepening Power-System Reform and Accelerating the Establishment of a New Power System. (CCTV News)

source_text_zh: 中国人民银行货币政策委员会于近期召开了2023年第二季度例会，提出了加大逆周期调节力度、保交楼贷款支持计划和支持科技型企业融资行动方案等重要意见。这些措施将成为下半年货币政策的关键内容。会议强调要加强逆周期调节，可能在需要时采取降准和降息等工具；同时，继续实施“保交楼贷款支持计划”，以稳定房地产市场并推动经济恢复；此外，还提到要落实对科技型企业的融资支持方案，以促进实体经济发展。会议指出金融政策调整应适应经济形势变化，并呼吁商业银行与地方政府协调实施相关政策。
display_text_en: The Monetary Policy Committee of the People's Bank of China recently held its regular meeting for the second quarter of 2023 and put forward important views including intensifying countercyclical adjustments, the loan-support programme for ensuring the delivery of pre-sold homes, and an action plan to support financing for technology companies. These measures will become key elements of monetary policy in the second half of the year. The meeting stressed the need to strengthen countercyclical adjustments, possibly using tools such as cuts to the reserve requirement ratio and interest rates when needed; at the same time, to continue implementing the loan-support programme for ensuring the delivery of pre-sold homes in order to stabilise the property market and promote economic recovery; and, in addition, to implement the financing-support plan for technology companies in order to promote development of the real economy. The meeting stated that financial-policy adjustments should adapt to changes in economic conditions and called on commercial banks and local governments to coordinate the implementation of the relevant policies.

source_text_zh: 6月20日，中国人民银行公布1年期贷款市场报价利率（LPR）下调至3.55%，5年期以上LPR降至4.2%，均降低10个基点。这是自2022年8月以来的首次下调，旨在刺激实体经济和提振房地产市场信心。专家分析认为，LPR的下降将促进银行贷款利率降低，从而激发融资需求并有助于房地产平稳发展。此外，业内人士预测后续货币政策可能进一步加码，包括降准和推出结构性政策工具，以支持高技术制造业等领域的发展。
display_text_en: On June 20, the People's Bank of China announced that the one-year loan prime rate (LPR) had been lowered to 3.55% and the LPR for terms of more than five years had been lowered to 4.2%, both decreases of 10 basis points. This was the first reduction since August 2022 and was intended to stimulate the real economy and bolster confidence in the property market. Experts analysed that the decline in the LPR would lead to lower bank lending rates, thereby stimulating financing demand and helping the property sector develop steadily. In addition, industry participants predicted that monetary policy might be intensified further, including a cut to the reserve requirement ratio and the introduction of structural policy tools, to support the development of fields such as high-technology manufacturing.

source_text_zh: 7月3日，卫宁健康公告称，公司实际控制人和董事长周炜于7月1日被茂名市监察委员会实施留置措施。公司其他管理层正常履职，目前经营未受影响。卫宁健康成立于1994年，是国内医疗健康信息化的龙头企业，截至公告发布，股价跌停至8.66元，总市值186亿元。周炜持有176,474,241股，估算市值约15.24亿元，其年薪为75万元。此外，卫宁健康正在研发医疗AI大语言模型WiNGPT，并与华为云建立战略合作关系。
display_text_en: On July 3, Winning Health announced that Zhou Wei, the company's actual controller and chairman, had been placed under detention measures by the Maoming Municipal Supervisory Commission on July 1. The company's other management personnel are performing their duties normally, and operations have not currently been affected. Founded in 1994, Winning Health is a leading domestic healthcare informatisation company. As of the announcement, its share price had fallen by the daily limit to RMB 8.66, giving it a total market capitalisation of RMB 18.6 billion. Zhou Wei holds 176,474,241 shares with an estimated market value of approximately RMB 1.524 billion, and his annual salary is RMB 750,000. In addition, Winning Health is developing the medical AI large language model WiNGPT and has established a strategic partnership with Huawei Cloud.

source_text_zh: 据中证报，中国人民银行授权全国银行间同业拆借中心6月20日公布，1年期贷款市场报价利率（LPR）为3.55%，5年期以上LPR为4.2%，均较上一期下降10个基点。专家认为，LPR下调将带动银行贷款利率下行，进而激发实体经济融资需求、提振房地产市场信心...
display_text_en: According to China Securities Journal, the National Interbank Funding Center, authorised by the People's Bank of China, announced on June 20 that the one-year loan prime rate (LPR) was 3.55% and the LPR for terms of more than five years was 4.2%, both down 10 basis points from the previous period. Experts believe that the LPR reductions will drive bank lending rates lower, thereby stimulating financing demand in the real economy and bolstering confidence in the property market...

source_text_zh: 中国人民银行货币政策委员会于6月28日在北京召开了2023年第二季度例会，会议指出当前宏观经济需求仍不强，外部环境复杂严峻，国内经济复苏力度不足。新增表述“内生动力还不强、需求驱动仍不足”反映出消费和投资增速低迷。央行强调将加大宏观政策调控力度，实施稳健的货币政策，并支持扩大内需和改善消费环境。同时，为应对人民币贬值风险，会议提出要稳定汇率并深化市场化改革。此外，物价走势受到关注，但预计下半年CPI将逐步回升。
display_text_en: The Monetary Policy Committee of the People's Bank of China held its regular meeting for the second quarter of 2023 in Beijing on June 28. The meeting stated that current macroeconomic demand remained weak, the external environment was complex and severe, and the domestic economic recovery lacked strength. The new wording, 'endogenous momentum remains weak and demand-driven growth remains insufficient,' reflected sluggish growth in consumption and investment. The central bank stressed that it would intensify macro-policy regulation, implement prudent monetary policy, and support the expansion of domestic demand and improvement of the consumption environment. At the same time, to address the risk of renminbi depreciation, the meeting proposed stabilising the exchange rate and deepening market-oriented reforms. In addition, price trends received attention, although the CPI was expected to rise gradually in the second half of the year.

source_text_zh: 中国人民银行近期下调了MLF操作利率和7天期逆回购利率，市场人士普遍认为这可能标志着降息周期的开始。5月份的金融数据显示，社会融资规模和人民币贷款均低于预期，这引发了对政策加码的预期。分析师指出，此次降息旨在刺激经济，缓解疲软的信贷需求。尽管降息是一个积极信号，但专家认为仍需更多政策支持来提振经济活力，包括降低存款准备金率和加强对房地产等行业的支持措施。同时，市场预计未来LPR也将随之调整，以进一步促进信贷增长。
display_text_en: The People's Bank of China recently lowered the medium-term lending facility (MLF) operation rate and the seven-day reverse-repurchase rate, and market participants generally believe this may mark the beginning of an interest-rate-cut cycle. Financial data for May showed that both aggregate social financing and renminbi loans were below expectations, prompting expectations of stronger policy action. Analysts noted that the rate cuts were intended to stimulate the economy and alleviate weak credit demand. Although the rate cuts were a positive signal, experts believed that more policy support was still needed to boost economic vitality, including reducing the reserve requirement ratio and strengthening support measures for sectors such as property. At the same time, the market expected the LPR to be adjusted accordingly in the future to promote further credit growth.

source_text_zh: 6月15日，中国人民银行宣布中期借贷便利（MLF）利率下调10个基点，此前7天期逆回购利率也已下降。这是自去年8月以来的首次MLF利率调整，分析师普遍预计6月份贷款市场报价利率（LPR）将大概率非对称下调，从而降低企业和居民特别是房贷利率。当前经济景气水平有所回落，政策利率的接连下调旨在提振市场信心并支持实体经济发展。
display_text_en: On June 15, the People's Bank of China announced a 10-basis-point reduction in the medium-term lending facility (MLF) rate, after the seven-day reverse-repurchase rate had also fallen. This was the first adjustment to the MLF rate since August last year. Analysts generally expected the loan prime rates (LPRs) for June to be highly likely to decline asymmetrically, thereby reducing rates for businesses and households, particularly mortgage rates. The current level of economic activity had declined somewhat, and the successive reductions in policy rates were intended to bolster market confidence and support development of the real economy.

source_text_zh: 【央行：进一步疏通货币政策传导机制 保持流动性合理充裕】央行货币政策委员会召开2023年第二季度例会，进一步疏通货币政策传导机制，保持流动性合理充裕，保持信贷合理增长、节奏平稳，保持货币供应量和社会融资规模增速同名义经济增速基本匹配。继续发挥好已投放的政策性开发性金融工具资金作用，增强政府投资和政策激励的引导作用，有效带动激发民间投资。关注物价走势边际变化，保持物价水平基本稳定。保持再贷款再贴现工具的稳定性，延续实施普惠小微贷款支持工具和保交楼贷款支持计划，继续加大对普惠金融、绿色发展、科技创新、基础设施建设等国民经济重点领域和薄弱环节的支持力度，综合施策支持区域协调发展。
display_text_en: [Central Bank: Further Unblock the Monetary-Policy Transmission Mechanism and Maintain Reasonably Ample Liquidity] The Monetary Policy Committee of the central bank held its regular meeting for the second quarter of 2023. It called for further unblocking the monetary-policy transmission mechanism, maintaining reasonably ample liquidity, keeping credit growth reasonable and its pace steady, and keeping growth in the money supply and aggregate social financing broadly in line with nominal economic growth. It called for continuing to make good use of funds already deployed through policy-based and development-oriented financial instruments, enhancing the guiding role of government investment and policy incentives, and effectively driving and stimulating private investment. It called for monitoring marginal changes in price trends and keeping the overall price level broadly stable. It called for maintaining the stability of relending and rediscount instruments, extending the implementation of the support instrument for inclusive loans to micro and small businesses and the loan-support programme for ensuring delivery of pre-sold homes, continuing to increase support for key fields and weak links in the national economy such as inclusive finance, green development, technological innovation, and infrastructure construction, and using a combination of measures to support coordinated regional development.

source_text_zh: 【新能源汽车购置税减免政策出台 理想：达成目标没有任何借口 蔚来：相对燃油豪华车优势巨大】6月21日，财政部、税务总局、工业和信息化部联合发布《关于延续和优化新能源汽车车辆购置税减免政策的公告》明确：2024-2025年，购置新能源汽车免征车辆购置税；2026-2027年，购置税减半征收。对此，作为中国新能源造车新势力代表的蔚来和理想汽车迅速给予积极回应，表达对新政策的欢迎。“非常好，直接给出了四年的稳定政策，我们团队要达成2025年的公司战略目标就没有任何借口了。2025年销售160万辆，营收5000亿元，2026年初验证！”理想汽车创始人、董事长李想表示。蔚来有关负责人表示，从现在到2027年，纯电动车仍然享有购置税减免优惠，这将使得蔚来相对于燃油豪华车在购置成本上有巨大优势。新的纯电动车购置税政策实施后，根据新政策，蔚来换电模式下的车电分离方式，可以明显帮助用户降低购车成本，减少在购车环节的购置税支出。（上证报）
display_text_en: [New-Energy Vehicle Purchase-Tax Relief Policy Introduced; Li Auto: No Excuse for Failing to Meet the Target; NIO: Huge Advantage over Luxury Fuel Vehicles] On June 21, the Ministry of Finance, the State Taxation Administration, and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology jointly issued the Announcement on Extending and Optimising the Vehicle Purchase-Tax Relief Policy for New-Energy Vehicles. It specified that purchases of new-energy vehicles in 2024-2025 would be exempt from vehicle purchase tax, while purchases in 2026-2027 would be subject to half the tax. In response, NIO and Li Auto, representatives of China's new generation of new-energy vehicle manufacturers, quickly responded positively and welcomed the new policy. 'This is excellent. It directly provides four years of policy stability, so our team has no excuse for failing to achieve the company's 2025 strategic goals. Sell 1.6 million vehicles and generate revenue of RMB 500 billion in 2025, to be verified at the beginning of 2026!' said Li Xiang, founder and chairman of Li Auto. A relevant NIO representative said that from now until 2027, battery-electric vehicles would continue to enjoy vehicle purchase-tax relief, giving NIO a huge advantage over luxury fuel vehicles in terms of purchase cost. After the new purchase-tax policy for battery-electric vehicles takes effect, under the new policy NIO's separation of vehicle and battery through its battery-swapping model can clearly help users lower the cost of buying a vehicle and reduce vehicle purchase-tax expenditure at the time of purchase. (Shanghai Securities News)

source_text_zh: 6月20日，中国人民银行宣布贷款市场报价利率（LPR）首次降息，1年期和5年期LPR均下调10个基点，分别为3.55%和4.2%。此次降息预计将降低首套房和二套房的月供，分别减少57元和60元。分析人士认为，此次降息有助于刺激实体经济、促进投资与消费，并可能进一步推动其他宏观政策措施。尽管市场对此次同步降息预期较高，但5年期LPR的下调幅度略低于预期，反映出房地产市场的调整需求。同时，银行面临净息差压力，可能会继续采取措施降低存款利率以支持实体经济。整体来看，此次政策释放了稳增长信号，为经济复苏提供了支撑。
display_text_en: On June 20, the People's Bank of China announced the first interest-rate cuts to the loan prime rates (LPRs), lowering both the one-year and five-year LPRs by 10 basis points to 3.55% and 4.2%, respectively. These rate cuts were expected to reduce the monthly payments on first-home and second-home mortgages by RMB 57 and RMB 60, respectively. Analysts believed the cuts would help stimulate the real economy, promote investment and consumption, and might further drive other macro-policy measures. Although the market had relatively strong expectations of simultaneous cuts, the reduction in the five-year LPR was slightly smaller than expected, reflecting the property market's need for adjustment. At the same time, banks faced pressure on their net interest margins and might continue taking measures to lower deposit rates to support the real economy. Overall, the policy sent a signal of stabilising growth and provided support for economic recovery.

source_text_zh: 6月16日，国务院总理李强主持召开常务会议，审议通过支持科技型企业融资的行动方案和私募投资基金监督管理条例（草案），并讨论学位法草案。会议强调要采取有力措施推动经济持续回升，包括加大宏观政策调控、扩大有效需求、优化实体经济和防范重点领域风险。同时，为科技型企业提供多元化金融服务，并强化私募基金行业的监管，以打击非法集资行为。会议指出，尽管经济整体回升，但内生动力不足的问题依然突出，需要加强政策实施和储备以确保稳增长。
display_text_en: On June 16, Premier Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting that reviewed and approved an action plan to support financing for technology companies and draft regulations on the supervision and administration of private investment funds, and discussed a draft academic degrees law. The meeting stressed the need to adopt forceful measures to promote a sustained economic recovery, including strengthening macro-policy regulation, expanding effective demand, optimising the real economy, and guarding against risks in key fields. It also called for providing diversified financial services to technology companies and strengthening supervision of the private-fund industry to combat illegal fundraising. The meeting stated that although the economy was recovering overall, insufficient endogenous momentum remained a prominent problem, and policy implementation and reserves needed to be strengthened to ensure stable growth.

source_text_zh: 【哥大教授：商业地产陷入“厄运循环”，将引爆新一轮银行危机】哥伦比亚大学商学院房地产与金融教授范·纽维尔伯格(Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh)对商业地产的“城市厄运循环”发出了警告。随着时间的推移，质量较低的写字楼价值可能会下跌45%，整个写字楼行业的价值将下降5000亿美元。其后果可能会影响银行业和更广泛的经济，因为地区性银行是商业地产的主要融资来源，这意味着它们可能会遇到今年早些时候令硅谷银行和Signature Bank破产的同样问题。
display_text_en: [Columbia Professor: Commercial Property Caught in a 'Doom Loop' That Will Trigger a New Banking Crisis] Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh, a professor of real estate and finance at Columbia Business School, warned of an 'urban doom loop' in commercial property. Over time, the value of lower-quality office buildings may fall by 45%, while the value of the office sector as a whole will decline by USD 500 billion. The consequences may affect the banking sector and the broader economy because regional banks are the principal source of financing for commercial property, meaning they may encounter the same problems that caused Silicon Valley Bank and Signature Bank to fail earlier this year.

source_text_zh: 6月20日，中国人民银行公布最新贷款市场报价利率（LPR），1年期和5年期以上LPR均下降10个基点，分别为3.55%和4.2%。这是自2022年8月以来LPR的首次调整。本月中期借贷便利（MLF）的中标利率也下降至2.65%，而逆回购操作的中标利率降至1.9%。专家认为，政策利率的下降将有效降低实际贷款利率，从而刺激信贷需求，促进消费和投资增长。
display_text_en: On June 20, the People's Bank of China announced the latest loan prime rates (LPRs). Both the one-year LPR and the LPR for terms of more than five years fell by 10 basis points, to 3.55% and 4.2%, respectively. This was the first LPR adjustment since August 2022. The winning bid rate on this month's medium-term lending facility (MLF) also fell to 2.65%, while the winning bid rate on reverse-repurchase operations declined to 1.9%. Experts believed that the reductions in policy rates would effectively lower actual lending rates, thereby stimulating credit demand and promoting growth in consumption and investment.

source_text_zh: 【LPR下调10个基点 新一轮稳增长持续加码】证券时报文章指出，由于新发放贷款已基本参考LPR定价，LPR下调将有效发挥方向性和指导性作用，进一步降低企业综合融资成本和个人消费信贷成本，尤其将降低购房者的置业成本，进而刺激实体经济需求。虽然6月LPR下调幅度引发市场对于政策力度的讨论，但受访专家一致认为，LPR下调仅是新一轮宏观政策调整的“先手棋”，反映政策稳增长力度正在加码，后续财政、货币政策都有可能出台更多增量措施稳经济大盘。
display_text_en: [LPRs Cut by 10 Basis Points as a New Round of Measures to Stabilise Growth Continues to Intensify] An article in Securities Times noted that, because newly issued loans are now generally priced with reference to the LPR, the reduction in the LPR would effectively play a directional and guiding role, further lowering companies' overall financing costs and individuals' consumer-credit costs. In particular, it would lower homebuyers' purchase costs and thereby stimulate demand in the real economy. Although the size of the LPR reduction in June prompted market discussion about the strength of policy, the experts interviewed unanimously believed that the reduction was only the 'opening move' in a new round of macro-policy adjustments, reflecting intensifying policy efforts to stabilise growth. Fiscal and monetary policies may subsequently introduce further incremental measures to stabilise the overall economy.

source_text_zh: 6月15日，人民银行宣布开展2370亿元中期借贷便利(MLF)操作，并将MLF利率下调10个基点至2.65%。此次政策调整旨在维护银行体系流动性和支持实体经济，专家认为这将刺激信贷需求并促进金融机构让利。随着6月MLF利率下降，预计贷款市场报价利率(LPR)也会相应调整，其中1年期LPR可能下降5个基点，而5年期以上LPR下降15个基点的概率较大，以拉动企业中长期贷款及居民按揭贷款。
display_text_en: On June 15, the People's Bank of China announced a RMB 237 billion medium-term lending facility (MLF) operation and lowered the MLF rate by 10 basis points to 2.65%. This policy adjustment was intended to maintain liquidity in the banking system and support the real economy. Experts believed it would stimulate credit demand and encourage financial institutions to pass on benefits. Following the decline in the MLF rate in June, the loan prime rates (LPRs) were also expected to be adjusted accordingly. The one-year LPR might fall by 5 basis points, while the probability of a 15-basis-point reduction in the LPR for terms of more than five years was relatively high, in order to drive medium- and long-term corporate lending and household mortgage lending.

source_text_zh: 【中国人民银行: 中国人民银行增加支农支小再贷款、再贴现额度2000亿】中国人民银行决定增加支农支小再贷款、再贴现额度2000亿元，进一步加大对“三农”、小微和民营企业金融支持力度，发挥精准滴灌作用，降低社会融资成本，促进扩大就业，支持经济内生动力恢复。其中，支农再贷款、支小再贷款、再贴现分别增加额度400亿元、1200亿元、400亿元，调增后额度分别为8000亿元、17600亿元、7400亿元。
display_text_en: [People's Bank of China: People's Bank of China Increases Quotas for Relending to Agriculture and Small Businesses and for Rediscounting by RMB 200 Billion] The People's Bank of China decided to increase the quotas for relending to agriculture and small businesses and for rediscounting by RMB 200 billion, further strengthening financial support for agriculture, rural areas and farmers, micro and small businesses, and private enterprises; providing precisely targeted support; lowering social financing costs; promoting the expansion of employment; and supporting the recovery of the economy's endogenous momentum. Of this amount, the quotas for relending to agriculture, relending to small businesses, and rediscounting were increased by RMB 40 billion, RMB 120 billion, and RMB 40 billion, respectively. After the increases, the respective quotas were RMB 800 billion, RMB 1.76 trillion, and RMB 740 billion.

source_text_zh: 据中国网，财政部副部长许宏才表示，为进一步巩固和扩大新能源汽车产业发展优势，6月2日国务院常务会议要求延续和优化新能源汽车车辆购置税减免政策，决定将新能源汽车车辆购置税减免政策延长至2027年年底，减免力度分年度逐步退坡，并对新能源...
display_text_en: According to China.org.cn, Vice Minister of Finance Xu Hongcai said that, to further consolidate and expand the development advantages of the new-energy vehicle industry, the State Council executive meeting on June 2 called for extending and optimising the vehicle purchase-tax relief policy for new-energy vehicles. It decided to extend the policy through the end of 2027, with the degree of relief gradually reduced year by year, and for new-energy...

source_text_zh: 6月15日，央行宣布将中期借贷便利（MLF）利率下调10个基点，这是自2022年8月以来的首次降息，并发出降息信号，预计6月20日贷款市场报价利率（LPR）也将下降。分析人士认为，1年期和5年期以上LPR可能出现非对称下调，其中1年期或下调5至10个基点，而5年期则可能下调15个基点。多位研究人员表示，此次降息标志着宽信用的开始，预料货币政策将继续宽松，包括未来可能的存款准备金率下调及其他财政刺激措施，以提振经济增长。
display_text_en: On June 15, the central bank announced a 10-basis-point reduction in the medium-term lending facility (MLF) rate. This was the first interest-rate cut since August 2022 and sent a signal of lower rates, with the loan prime rates (LPRs) also expected to fall on June 20. Analysts believed that the one-year LPR and the LPR for terms of more than five years might be reduced asymmetrically: the one-year rate might fall by 5 to 10 basis points, while the five-year rate might fall by 15 basis points. Several researchers said that the rate cut marked the beginning of credit easing and expected monetary policy to remain accommodative, including a possible future cut to the reserve requirement ratio and other fiscal stimulus measures, in order to boost economic growth.

source_text_zh: 【国家发改委主任：要把维护产业安全放在更加突出的位置 加强关键核心技术攻关和战略性资源支撑】国家发展改革委主任郑栅洁在《求是》发表署名文章：加快建设以实体经济为支撑的现代化产业体系。统筹好发展和安全。安全是发展的前提，发展是安全的保障，缺少安全保障的产业体系，势必受到各类风险挑战的冲击，安全和发展要同步推进。要把维护产业安全放在更加突出的位置，加强关键核心技术攻关和战略性资源支撑，努力构建自主可控、安全高效的产业链供应链，打造有利于现代化产业体系可持续发展的安全“防火墙”。同时，要强化底线思维，增强忧患意识，科学预研预判工业经济运行、产业发展形势的变化趋势，警惕“黑天鹅”、防范“灰犀牛”，积极应对、稳妥处理，避免发生重大风险或危机。
display_text_en: [NDRC Chairman: Give Industrial Security Greater Prominence and Strengthen Breakthroughs in Key Core Technologies and Support from Strategic Resources] Zheng Shanjie, Chairman of the National Development and Reform Commission, published a signed article in Qiushi entitled 'Accelerating the Construction of a Modern Industrial System Supported by the Real Economy.' The article called for coordinating development and security. Security is the prerequisite for development, and development is the safeguard for security. An industrial system without security safeguards will inevitably be exposed to all kinds of risks and challenges, so security and development must be advanced in parallel. Industrial security must be given greater prominence, breakthroughs in key core technologies and support from strategic resources must be strengthened, efforts must be made to build independent and controllable, secure and efficient industrial and supply chains, and a security 'firewall' conducive to the sustainable development of a modern industrial system must be created. At the same time, bottom-line thinking must be strengthened, awareness of potential dangers heightened, changes and trends in industrial economic operations and industrial development scientifically researched and assessed in advance, 'black swans' watched for and 'grey rhinos' guarded against, and situations actively addressed and handled prudently to avoid major risks or crises.

source_text_zh: 6月21日，国新办举行国务院政策例行吹风会，宣布将新能源汽车购置税减免政策延续至2027年，以促进新能源汽车产业高质量发展。具体措施包括对2024年至2025年购置的新能源汽车免征车辆购置税，而2026年至2027年则减半征收。此外，国家还计划加强充电基础设施建设，以解决充电难题，并提出一系列支持政策，包括加大价格支持和金融服务能力。预计到2030年，将基本建成覆盖广泛、高质量的充电基础设施体系。
display_text_en: On June 21, the State Council Information Office held a regular State Council policy briefing and announced that the vehicle purchase-tax relief policy for new-energy vehicles would be extended through 2027 to promote high-quality development of the new-energy vehicle industry. The specific measures include exempting new-energy vehicles purchased from 2024 to 2025 from vehicle purchase tax and levying half the tax from 2026 to 2027. In addition, the state plans to strengthen construction of charging infrastructure to address charging difficulties and has proposed a series of supporting policies, including stronger price support and financial-service capacity. By 2030, a high-quality charging infrastructure system with broad coverage is expected to have been largely established.

source_text_zh: 6月20日，中国央行公布贷款市场报价利率（LPR），1年期和5年期分别下调10个基点，至3.55%和4.20%。此次下调是自去年8月份以来的首次，反映出宏观经济复苏需要货币政策的持续发力。降低LPR旨在刺激信贷需求、消费及其他需求，为实体企业和住户减轻融资成本，并促进住房消费，从而助力房地产业的健康发展。这一变化预计将激活市场活力，也为未来进一步降息留出空间。
display_text_en: On June 20, the People's Bank of China announced the loan prime rates (LPRs), lowering the one-year and five-year rates by 10 basis points to 3.55% and 4.20%, respectively. These were the first reductions since August last year, reflecting the need for continued monetary-policy support for the macroeconomic recovery. Lowering the LPRs was intended to stimulate credit demand, consumption, and other demand; reduce financing costs for businesses in the real economy and households; and promote housing consumption, thereby supporting healthy development of the property industry. The change was expected to activate market vitality and also leave room for further interest-rate cuts in the future.

source_text_zh: 中国人民银行于6月15日宣布，为维护银行体系流动性，将开展2370亿元一年期中期借贷便利（MLF）操作和20亿元7天期逆回购操作，利率分别为2.65%和1.90%。此次MLF中标利率较上月下调10个基点，市场分析认为这一举措将促进货币信贷增长、降低企业融资成本，并传递出支持实体经济的政策信号。预计此轮利率调整将带动贷款市场报价利率（LPR）跟进下调，从而进一步减轻企业和居民的贷款负担。
display_text_en: On June 15, the People's Bank of China announced that, to maintain liquidity in the banking system, it would conduct a RMB 237 billion one-year medium-term lending facility (MLF) operation and a RMB 2 billion seven-day reverse-repurchase operation, at rates of 2.65% and 1.90%, respectively. The winning bid rate on the MLF was 10 basis points lower than in the previous month. Market analysts believed this measure would promote growth in money and credit, lower corporate financing costs, and send a policy signal of support for the real economy. This round of rate adjustments was expected to prompt corresponding reductions in the loan prime rates (LPRs), thereby further easing the loan burden on businesses and households.

source_text_zh: 央行消息，初步统计，6月末社会融资规模存量为365.45万亿元，同比增长9%。其中，对实体经济发放的人民币贷款余额为228.86万亿元，同比增长11.2%；对实体经济发放的外币贷款折合人民币余额为1.89万亿元，同比下降18.9%；委托贷款余额为11.32万亿...
display_text_en: According to the central bank, preliminary statistics showed that the stock of aggregate social financing at the end of June was RMB 365.45 trillion, up 9% year on year. Of this, the balance of renminbi loans issued to the real economy was RMB 228.86 trillion, up 11.2% year on year; the renminbi-equivalent balance of foreign-currency loans issued to the real economy was RMB 1.89 trillion, down 18.9% year on year; and the balance of entrusted loans was RMB 11.32 trillion...

source_text_zh: 美联储于6月15日宣布将联邦基金利率维持在5%至5.25%的区间，这是自去年3月以来首次暂停加息。尽管如此，会议点阵图暗示今年仍可能有两次25个基点的加息。美联储主席鲍威尔表示，虽然此次选择暂停，但几乎所有决策者认为进一步提高利率是合适的，同时强调降息在2023年不太可能。经济预期显示，美联储大幅上调了对2023年美国GDP增长的预期，从0.4%增至1.0%，而核心通胀预期则有所上升。最新数据显示，美国整体通胀呈回落趋势，这可能影响未来政策走向。
display_text_en: On June 15, the Federal Reserve announced that it would keep the federal funds rate within the range of 5% to 5.25%, the first pause in rate increases since March last year. Nevertheless, the meeting's dot plot suggested that there might still be two increases of 25 basis points each this year. Federal Reserve Chair Powell said that, although a pause had been chosen this time, almost all policymakers believed further rate increases would be appropriate, while emphasising that rate cuts were unlikely in 2023. Economic projections showed that the Federal Reserve sharply raised its forecast for US GDP growth in 2023 from 0.4% to 1.0%, while its forecast for core inflation rose somewhat. The latest data showed an overall downward trend in US inflation, which might affect the future direction of policy.

source_text_zh: 2023年6月20日，中国人民银行公布贷款市场报价利率（LPR），1年期LPR为3.55%，5年期以上LPR为4.2%，均下调10个基点，这是自2022年8月以来的首次下调。这次降息主要受到银行存款利率降低的影响，活期和定期存款利率分别下调5至15个基点。此次调整预计将降低居民住房贷款成本，并提振房地产需求。同时，这也有助于改善实体经济融资需求，刺激信贷和投资增长。尽管预期存在非对称降息，但最终两类期限LPR同幅度下调，显示政策稳健与适度。展望未来，后续财政和产业政策有望跟进以促进经济复苏。
display_text_en: On June 20, 2023, the People's Bank of China announced the loan prime rates (LPRs): the one-year LPR was 3.55% and the LPR for terms of more than five years was 4.2%, both down 10 basis points. These were the first reductions since August 2022. The rate cuts were mainly influenced by reductions in bank deposit rates, with demand- and time-deposit rates lowered by 5 to 15 basis points. The adjustments were expected to reduce households' housing-loan costs and boost property demand. They would also help improve financing demand in the real economy and stimulate growth in credit and investment. Although asymmetric rate cuts had been expected, the two LPR maturities were ultimately reduced by the same amount, demonstrating a prudent and measured policy approach. Looking ahead, subsequent fiscal and industrial policies were expected to follow in order to promote economic recovery.

source_text_zh: 6月21日，国新办举行发布会，介绍促进新能源汽车产业高质量发展的政策。工信部副部长辛国斌透露，今年前五个月，新能源汽车产销分别达到300.5万辆和294万辆，同比分别增长45.1%和46.8%。为了支持该产业发展，财政部将新能源汽车车辆购置税减免政策延长至2027年底，并设定每辆新能源乘用车的免税额上限为3万元，自2026年起减半征收。预计2024年至2027年期间，该政策将使总减免车辆购置税规模达到5200亿元。这些措施旨在稳定市场预期、鼓励消费并推动行业高质量发展。
display_text_en: On June 21, the State Council Information Office held a press conference to introduce policies promoting high-quality development of the new-energy vehicle industry. Xin Guobin, Vice Minister of Industry and Information Technology, disclosed that in the first five months of this year, production and sales of new-energy vehicles reached 3.005 million and 2.94 million, respectively, representing year-on-year growth of 45.1% and 46.8%. To support development of the industry, the Ministry of Finance extended the vehicle purchase-tax relief policy for new-energy vehicles through the end of 2027 and set a maximum tax exemption of RMB 30,000 for each new-energy passenger vehicle, with half the tax to be levied from 2026. The policy was expected to provide total vehicle purchase-tax relief of RMB 520 billion from 2024 to 2027. These measures were intended to stabilise market expectations, encourage consumption, and promote high-quality development of the industry.

source_text_zh: 财政部副部长许宏才在6月21日的国务院政策例行吹风会上宣布，新能源汽车车辆购置税减免政策将延长至2027年年底。
display_text_en: At the State Council regular policy briefing on June 21, Vice Minister of Finance Xu Hongcai announced that the vehicle purchase-tax relief policy for new-energy vehicles would be extended through the end of 2027.

source_text_zh: 【国家发改委主任郑栅洁：坚决防范系统性风险 重点要抓好“四大安全”】国家发展改革委党组书记、主任郑栅洁撰文指出，坚决防范系统性风险，促进高质量发展和高水平安全的良性互动，以新安全格局保障新发展格局。重点要抓好“四大安全”：一是粮食安全。要严格落实粮食安全党政同责、耕地保护党政同责，实施新一轮千亿斤粮食产能提升行动，持续强化粮食产购储加销协同保障，健全种粮农民收益保障和主产区利益补偿机制，全力做好粮食保供稳价，全方位夯实粮食安全根基。二是能源资源安全。要深入推进能源革命，加快规划建设新型能源体系，加强能源产供储销体系建设。加大资源勘探开发力度。加强国家储备体系建设，优化完善储备布局和设施网络。三是产业链供应链安全稳定。要发挥保持产业链供应链安全稳定重点企业、重点园区作用，实施产业链供应链贯通工程。提升制造业核心竞争力，深入实施强链补链行动，补强产业链薄弱环节，锻造一批产业链长板，促进全产业链优化升级。四是数据安全。要强化数据安全保障体系建设，把安全贯穿数据治理全过程，切实保障国家数据安全。
display_text_en: [NDRC Chairman Zheng Shanjie: Resolutely Prevent Systemic Risks, with a Focus on Four Major Areas of Security] Zheng Shanjie, Secretary of the Leading Party Members Group and Chairman of the National Development and Reform Commission, wrote that systemic risks must be resolutely prevented, positive interaction between high-quality development and high-level security must be promoted, and the new development pattern must be safeguarded through a new security framework. The focus must be on four major areas of security. First is food security. The system under which both Party committees and governments assume responsibility for food security and for protecting cultivated land must be strictly implemented; a new round of action to increase grain-production capacity by 100 billion jin must be carried out; coordinated safeguards for grain production, purchasing, storage, processing, and sales must be continuously strengthened; mechanisms to safeguard the income of grain farmers and compensate principal producing regions must be improved; every effort must be made to ensure grain supply and stable prices; and the foundations of food security must be comprehensively consolidated. Second is energy and resource security. The energy revolution must be advanced in depth, planning and construction of a new energy system accelerated, and systems for energy production, supply, storage, and sales strengthened. Resource exploration and development must be intensified. Construction of the national reserve system must be strengthened, and the reserve layout and facility network optimised and improved. Third is the security and stability of industrial and supply chains. The role of key enterprises and key industrial parks in maintaining the security and stability of industrial and supply chains must be brought into play, and projects to connect industrial and supply chains must be implemented. The core competitiveness of manufacturing must be enhanced, actions to strengthen and supplement chains implemented in depth, weak links in industrial chains reinforced, a number of areas of industrial-chain strength forged, and optimisation and upgrading of entire industrial chains promoted. Fourth is data security. Construction of the data-security safeguard system must be strengthened, security must run through the entire data-governance process, and national data security must be effectively protected.

source_text_zh: 【国常会审议通过《私募投资基金监督管理条例(草案)》】李强主持召开国务院常务会议，审议通过《私募投资基金监督管理条例(草案)》。会议指出，近年来，我国私募投资基金行业发展较快，在服务实体经济、支持创业创新等方面发挥了积极作用。制定专门行政法规，将私募投资基金业务活动纳入法治化、规范化轨道进行监管，有利于更好保护投资者合法权益，促进行业规范健康发展。要针对行业突出问题强化源头管控，划定监管底线，严厉打击以“私募基金”之名行非法集资之实等非法金融活动。要加强监督管理和发展政策的协同配合，对不同类别私募投资基金特别是创业投资基金实施差异化监管，抓紧出台促进创业投资基金发展的具体政策。（央视）
display_text_en: [State Council Executive Meeting Reviews and Approves Draft Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of Private Investment Funds] Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting that reviewed and approved the draft Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of Private Investment Funds. The meeting stated that China's private investment-fund industry had developed rapidly in recent years and had played a positive role in serving the real economy and supporting entrepreneurship and innovation. Formulating dedicated administrative regulations and bringing private investment-fund business activities under law-based and standardised supervision would help better protect investors' lawful rights and interests and promote the industry's standardised and healthy development. Source controls must be strengthened in response to prominent industry problems, regulatory red lines drawn, and illegal financial activities such as illegal fundraising conducted in the name of 'private funds' severely punished. Coordination between supervision and development policies must be strengthened, differentiated supervision applied to different categories of private investment funds, particularly venture-capital funds, and specific policies to promote the development of venture-capital funds introduced promptly. (CCTV)

source_text_zh: 【央行：6月末社会融资规模存量为365.45万亿元，同比增长9%】央行消息，初步统计，6月末社会融资规模存量为365.45万亿元，同比增长9%。其中，对实体经济发放的人民币贷款余额为228.86万亿元，同比增长11.2%；对实体经济发放的外币贷款折合人民币余额为1.89万亿元，同比下降18.9%；委托贷款余额为11.32万亿元，同比增长4.1%；信托贷款余额为3.77万亿元，同比下降5.1%；未贴现的银行承兑汇票余额为2.75万亿元，同比下降2.8%；企业债券余额为31.34万亿元，同比下降0.4%；政府债券余额为63.57万亿元，同比增长10.1%；非金融企业境内股票余额为11.1万亿元，同比增长11.4%。
display_text_en: [Central Bank: Stock of Aggregate Social Financing at RMB 365.45 Trillion at End-June, Up 9% Year on Year] According to the central bank, preliminary statistics showed that the stock of aggregate social financing at the end of June was RMB 365.45 trillion, up 9% year on year. Of this, the balance of renminbi loans issued to the real economy was RMB 228.86 trillion, up 11.2% year on year; the renminbi-equivalent balance of foreign-currency loans issued to the real economy was RMB 1.89 trillion, down 18.9% year on year; the balance of entrusted loans was RMB 11.32 trillion, up 4.1% year on year; the balance of trust loans was RMB 3.77 trillion, down 5.1% year on year; the balance of undiscounted bankers' acceptances was RMB 2.75 trillion, down 2.8% year on year; the balance of corporate bonds was RMB 31.34 trillion, down 0.4% year on year; the balance of government bonds was RMB 63.57 trillion, up 10.1% year on year; and the balance of domestic shares of non-financial enterprises was RMB 11.1 trillion, up 11.4% year on year.

source_text_zh: 央行于2023年6月15日发布消息，为维护银行体系流动性，开展了2370亿元的中期借贷便利（MLF）操作和20亿元的公开市场逆回购操作。此次MLF中标利率为2.65%，较之前的2.75%下调10个基点，以满足金融机构的资金需求。
display_text_en: On June 15, 2023, the central bank announced that, to maintain liquidity in the banking system, it had conducted a RMB 237 billion medium-term lending facility (MLF) operation and a RMB 2 billion open-market reverse-repurchase operation. The winning bid rate on the MLF was 2.65%, down 10 basis points from the previous 2.75%, in order to meet financial institutions' funding needs.

source_text_zh: 6月15日，人民银行进行2370亿元1年期中期借贷便利（MLF）操作，中标利率为2.65%，较上月下降10个基点。这一降息措施与6月13日的公开市场逆回购利率下调相呼应，表明政策利率联动下调，以释放稳增长信号并加强对实体经济的支持。专家预测，随着MLF利率下调，本月20日公布的贷款市场报价利率（LPR）有望再降5-10个基点，这将降低融资成本、提振市场信心，并促进房地产市场健康发展。
display_text_en: On June 15, the People's Bank of China conducted a RMB 237 billion one-year medium-term lending facility (MLF) operation at a winning bid rate of 2.65%, down 10 basis points from the previous month. This interest-rate cut echoed the reduction in the open-market reverse-repurchase rate on June 13, indicating coordinated reductions in policy rates to send a signal of stabilising growth and strengthen support for the real economy. Experts predicted that, following the reduction in the MLF rate, the loan prime rates (LPRs) to be announced on the 20th of the month were expected to fall by a further 5 to 10 basis points. This would lower financing costs, bolster market confidence, and promote healthy development of the property market.

source_text_zh: 中国人民银行、国家金融监督管理总局印发关于延长金融支持房地产市场平稳健康发展有关政策期限的通知，有关政策有适用期限的，将适用期限统一延长至2024年12月31日。
display_text_en: The People's Bank of China and the National Financial Regulatory Administration issued a notice on extending the terms of relevant policies providing financial support for the stable and healthy development of the property market. Where the relevant policies have an applicable term, that term will be uniformly extended through December 31, 2024.

source_text_zh: 蓝盾转退正式进入退市整理期，成为历史上首支强制退市的可转债。开盘时暴跌67.31%，最低跌幅达到70%。尽管如此，随后股价拉升30%并触发熔断停牌。与此同时，其正股蓝盾退也进入退市整理期，开盘暴跌37.5%。根据公告，退市整理期从2023年7月10日开始，为期十五个交易日，预计最后交易日期为7月28日。在此期间不实行价格涨跌幅限制，但之后每个交易日的涨跌幅限制为20%。此次退市源于蓝盾因财务问题被交易所强制退市。
display_text_en: Landun Zhuantui formally entered the delisting-consolidation period, becoming the first convertible bond in history to be mandatorily delisted. It plunged 67.31% at the open and fell by as much as 70%. Despite this, its price subsequently rose by 30%, triggering a circuit-breaker trading suspension. At the same time, its underlying stock, Landun Tui, also entered the delisting-consolidation period and plunged 37.5% at the open. According to the announcement, the delisting-consolidation period began on July 10, 2023 and would last for 15 trading days, with the final trading date expected to be July 28. During this period there would be no price-movement limit, but thereafter the price-movement limit for each trading day would be 20%. The delisting resulted from the exchange mandatorily delisting Landun because of financial problems.

source_text_zh: 美联储主席鲍威尔在周四的听证会上表示，今年再次加息两次是适当的，委员会大多数成员认为利率还有上升空间。他指出经济有可能实现软着陆，但紧缩金融条件需要时间才能显现效果。尽管通胀有所下降，主要因能源和食品价格下跌，他强调解决通胀问题仍面临挑战。同时，鲍威尔提到银行监管方面的问题，特别是对硅谷银行的监管失误，并表示美联储计划提高大型银行的资本要求。最后，他关注小型银行在商业地产领域的风险敞口，并积极采取措施以帮助这些银行应对集中风险。
display_text_en: Federal Reserve Chair Powell said at a hearing on Thursday that it would be appropriate to raise interest rates twice more this year and that most committee members believed there was room for rates to rise further. He noted that the economy might achieve a soft landing, but that the effects of tighter financial conditions would take time to emerge. Although inflation had declined, mainly because of falling energy and food prices, he emphasised that challenges remained in addressing inflation. Powell also mentioned problems with banking supervision, particularly the failure to supervise Silicon Valley Bank, and said the Federal Reserve planned to raise capital requirements for large banks. Finally, he focused on small banks' exposure to commercial property and said measures were being actively taken to help those banks address concentration risks.

source_text_zh: 【国家发改委主任郑栅洁：坚持社会主义市场经济改革方向】国家发改委主任郑栅洁在《学习时报》发表文章指出，要坚持社会主义市场经济改革方向，推动有效市场和有为政府更好结合。坚持“两个毫不动摇”。深化国资国企改革，推动国有资本和国有企业做强做优做大，优化民营企业发展环境，加快落实促进民营经济发展壮大的政策举措，依法保护外商投资权益，破除影响各类所有制企业公平竞争、共同发展的法律法规障碍和隐性壁垒。完善市场经济基础制度。在产权保护、市场准入、公平竞争、社会信用等领域强化制度建设和监管，加强反垄断和反不正当竞争。加快建设全国统一大市场。深化要素市场化改革，统筹推进现代化基础设施体系和高标准市场体系建设，营造市场化法治化国际化一流营商环境。
display_text_en: [NDRC Chairman Zheng Shanjie: Adhere to the Direction of Socialist Market-Economy Reform] In an article published in Study Times, Zheng Shanjie, Chairman of the National Development and Reform Commission, stated that the direction of socialist market-economy reform must be upheld and that effective markets and a well-functioning government must be better combined. The 'two unwavering commitments' must be upheld. Reform of state-owned capital and state-owned enterprises must be deepened; state capital and state-owned enterprises must become stronger, better, and larger; the environment for the development of private enterprises must be optimised; implementation of policy measures to promote the development and growth of the private economy must be accelerated; the rights and interests of foreign investors must be protected according to law; and legal and regulatory obstacles and hidden barriers affecting fair competition and common development among enterprises under all forms of ownership must be removed. The foundational institutions of the market economy must be improved. Institution-building and supervision in areas such as protection of property rights, market access, fair competition, and social credit must be strengthened, as must antitrust and action against unfair competition. Construction of a unified national market must be accelerated. Market-oriented reform of factors of production must be deepened, construction of a modern infrastructure system and a high-standard market system advanced in a coordinated manner, and a first-class market-oriented, law-based, and internationalised business environment created.

source_text_zh: 7月4日，港股市场的小金属及矿物概念股普遍上涨，中国金石涨近23%，中国稀土涨近9%，金力永磁涨5%。中国商务部宣布从8月1日起对镓、锗相关物项实施出口管制，以维护国家安全和利益，出口商需办理许可手续。中国是全球最大的镓、锗生产国，分别占全球产量的95%和67%。
display_text_en: On July 4, small-metals and minerals concept stocks in the Hong Kong market generally rose. China Kingstone Mining climbed nearly 23%, China Rare Earth rose nearly 9%, and JL MAG Rare-Earth gained 5%. China's Ministry of Commerce announced that export controls on gallium- and germanium-related items would take effect on August 1 to safeguard national security and interests, and exporters would need to complete licensing procedures. China is the world's largest producer of gallium and germanium, accounting for 95% and 67% of global production, respectively.

source_text_zh: 6月15日，人民银行开展了2370亿元的1年期中期借贷便利（MLF）操作，中标利率为2.65%，较上月下降10个基点。同时，人民银行还进行了20亿元的7天期逆回购操作，中标利率为1.90%。
display_text_en: On June 15, the People's Bank of China conducted a RMB 237 billion one-year medium-term lending facility (MLF) operation at a winning bid rate of 2.65%, down 10 basis points from the previous month. At the same time, the People's Bank of China also conducted a RMB 2 billion seven-day reverse-repurchase operation at a winning bid rate of 1.90%.

source_text_zh: 【国家发改委主任：构建新一代信息技术、人工智能、生物技术、新能源、新材料、高端装备、绿色环保等一批新的增长引擎】国家发展改革委主任郑栅洁在《求是》发表署名文章《加快建设以实体经济为支撑的现代化产业体系》。文章指出，打造新的增长引擎。加快推进前沿技术研发和应用，推动战略性新兴产业融合集群发展，深入实施国家战略性新兴产业集群发展工程，构建新一代信息技术、人工智能、生物技术、新能源、新材料、高端装备、绿色环保等一批新的增长引擎。加强全产业链攻关、全要素支持、全生态发展，推动重大战略产业发展。对前沿技术、颠覆性技术进行多路径探索，推动建立国家未来产业先导区，超前谋划布局一批未来产业。
display_text_en: [NDRC Chairman: Build a Group of New Growth Engines, Including Next-Generation Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Biotechnology, New Energy, New Materials, High-End Equipment, and Green Environmental Protection] Zheng Shanjie, Chairman of the National Development and Reform Commission, published a signed article in Qiushi entitled 'Accelerating the Construction of a Modern Industrial System Supported by the Real Economy.' The article called for creating new growth engines. Research, development, and application of frontier technologies must be accelerated; the integrated and clustered development of strategic emerging industries promoted; the national project for developing strategic emerging-industry clusters implemented in depth; and a group of new growth engines built, including next-generation information technology, artificial intelligence, biotechnology, new energy, new materials, high-end equipment, and green environmental protection. Efforts throughout entire industrial chains, support covering all factors, and ecosystem-wide development must be strengthened to promote the development of major strategic industries. Multiple pathways for frontier and disruptive technologies must be explored, the establishment of national pilot zones for future industries promoted, and the planning and layout of a group of future industries undertaken in advance.

source_text_zh: 6月20日，中国贷款市场报价利率（LPR）公布，1年期LPR为3.55%，5年期以上LPR为4.20%，均下降10个基点。这是自去年以来首次同时下降，反映出宏观经济恢复乏力和社会需求不足的现实。分析认为，此次LPR下降主要由于银行负债成本降低、央行降准及政策利率下调等因素。预计降息将有助于降低企业和居民融资成本，促进房地产市场健康发展，并激励消费增长。专家建议采取差别化住房信贷政策，支持改善性住房需求，同时应加强货币、财政和产业政策的协调，以应对经济面临的多重挑战。
display_text_en: On June 20, China's loan prime rates (LPRs) were announced. The one-year LPR was 3.55% and the LPR for terms of more than five years was 4.20%, both down 10 basis points. This was the first simultaneous decline since last year, reflecting the reality of a weak macroeconomic recovery and insufficient social demand. Analysis indicated that the LPR declines were mainly due to factors including lower bank funding costs, a cut in the reserve requirement ratio by the central bank, and reductions in policy rates. The rate cuts were expected to help lower financing costs for businesses and households, promote healthy development of the property market, and encourage consumption growth. Experts recommended adopting differentiated housing-credit policies to support demand for improved housing, while strengthening coordination among monetary, fiscal, and industrial policies to address the multiple challenges facing the economy.

source_text_zh: 6月14日下午，国务院新闻办公室举行政策例行吹风会，国家发展改革委副秘书长袁达介绍了深化营商环境改革的重点措施。他强调党中央、国务院高度重视优化营商环境，并将推出针对性政策以解决企业反映的突出问题。袁达提到将着力深化市场化改革、强化法治支撑和提升国际化水平，同时推动区域间营商环境差距缩小。此外，他指出要健全法律制度体系、规范行政执法、加强经营主体权益保护，并促进外资吸引力度，以推动经济高质量发展。
display_text_en: On the afternoon of June 14, the State Council Information Office held a regular policy briefing at which Yuan Da, Deputy Secretary-General of the National Development and Reform Commission, introduced key measures to deepen business-environment reform. He emphasised that the CPC Central Committee and the State Council attached great importance to optimising the business environment and would introduce targeted policies to resolve prominent problems reported by enterprises. Yuan said efforts would focus on deepening market-oriented reform, strengthening support from the rule of law, and raising the level of internationalisation, while narrowing gaps in the business environment among regions. He also said that the system of laws and institutions must be improved, administrative law enforcement standardised, protection of the rights and interests of business entities strengthened, and efforts to attract foreign investment promoted, in order to advance high-quality economic development.

source_text_zh: 美联储宣布本次会议不加息，维持联邦基金利率目标区间在5%至5.25%，这是美联储自去年3月以来累计加息十次后首次暂停加息。
display_text_en: The Federal Reserve announced that it would not raise interest rates at this meeting and would maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 5% to 5.25%. This was the Federal Reserve's first pause after ten cumulative rate increases since March last year.

source_text_zh: 退市未来：公司股票将于2023年6月28日被上海证券交易所终止上市暨摘牌。
display_text_en: Future Delisting: The company's shares will be terminated from listing and delisted by the Shanghai Stock Exchange on June 28, 2023.

source_text_zh: 【货币政策工具箱打开，金融“法宝”各显神通】 支农支小再贷款、再贴现额度增加2000亿元；七天期逆回购利率、常备借贷便利（SLF）利率、中期借贷便利（MLF）利率等央行政策利率下行，贷款市场报价利率（LPR）年内首降……近期，货币政策工具箱中总量工具和结构性工具齐“上阵”，为实体经济提供更有力支持。展望下半年，为进一步推动经济持续回升向好、提振经营主体信心，货币政策操作将进一步加码。（经参）
display_text_en: [Monetary-Policy Toolbox Opens, with Each Financial 'Magic Weapon' Displaying Its Powers] The quotas for relending to agriculture and small businesses and for rediscounting were increased by RMB 200 billion; central-bank policy rates including the seven-day reverse-repurchase rate, the standing lending facility (SLF) rate, and the medium-term lending facility (MLF) rate declined; and the loan prime rates (LPRs) fell for the first time this year... Recently, aggregate and structural tools in the monetary-policy toolbox have been deployed together to provide stronger support for the real economy. Looking to the second half of the year, monetary-policy operations will be intensified further to promote a sustained economic recovery and improvement and bolster the confidence of business entities. (Economic Information Daily)

source_text_zh: 6月20日，中国人民银行公布最新贷款市场报价利率（LPR），1年期LPR下调至3.55%，5年期以上LPR降至4.2%，均较上月下调10个基点。专家认为，此次降息将增强实体经济活力，促进投资和消费，同时降低企业和个人的融资成本。分析指出，近期存款利率下调和政策性降息为此提供了空间，信贷需求亟需通过利率调降来提振。未来仍可能有进一步降息的空间，以支持经济恢复与发展。
display_text_en: On June 20, the People's Bank of China announced the latest loan prime rates (LPRs), lowering the one-year LPR to 3.55% and the LPR for terms of more than five years to 4.2%, both down 10 basis points from the previous month. Experts believed the rate cuts would strengthen vitality in the real economy, promote investment and consumption, and lower financing costs for businesses and individuals. Analysis indicated that recent reductions in deposit rates and policy rates had created room for the move and that credit demand urgently needed to be boosted through rate cuts. There might still be room for further interest-rate reductions in the future to support economic recovery and development.

source_text_zh: 近期公布的5月经济数据显示投资、消费和出口均低于预期，居民消费物价指数处于低位，工业生产者价格指数降幅扩大，表明经济复苏放缓，需求不足成为主要问题。国务院常务会议研究推出稳增长政策，并且央行下调多项利率以刺激经济。制造业PMI降至48.8%，服务业也出现回落，显示生产和需求同步下滑。此外，固定资产投资同比增速连续三个月下降，社零总额增速回落，而CPI略有上升。整体来看，全球经济下行压力加大，我国面临外需减弱和信贷需求放缓等挑战。
display_text_en: Recently released economic data for May showed that investment, consumption, and exports were all below expectations, the consumer price index was at a low level, and the decline in the producer price index widened, indicating that the economic recovery was slowing and that insufficient demand had become the main problem. A State Council executive meeting studied the introduction of policies to stabilise growth, while the central bank lowered several interest rates to stimulate the economy. The manufacturing PMI fell to 48.8%, and the services sector also declined, showing simultaneous falls in production and demand. In addition, year-on-year growth in fixed-asset investment fell for a third consecutive month, growth in total retail sales of consumer goods slowed, while the CPI rose slightly. Overall, downward pressure on the global economy increased, and China faced challenges including weaker external demand and slowing credit demand.

source_text_zh: 6月20日，中国人民银行宣布贷款市场报价利率（LPR）结束连续9个月保持不变，1年期和5年期以上LPR均下调10个基点，分别为3.55%和4.2%。分析人士认为，此次降息将对房地产市场、信贷市场及经济复苏产生积极影响，购房者的贷款成本将降低，从而提振市场信心。预计未来货币政策可能继续加码，包括降准和降息。多位专家指出，LPR下行有助于降低融资成本，刺激消费与投资，同时也为实现全年经济增长目标提供支持。
display_text_en: On June 20, the People's Bank of China announced that the loan prime rates (LPRs) had ended nine consecutive months of remaining unchanged. Both the one-year LPR and the LPR for terms of more than five years were lowered by 10 basis points, to 3.55% and 4.2%, respectively. Analysts believed the rate cuts would have a positive effect on the property market, the credit market, and the economic recovery. Homebuyers' borrowing costs would fall, thereby bolstering market confidence. Monetary policy was expected to be intensified further in the future, possibly including cuts to the reserve requirement ratio and interest rates. Several experts noted that lower LPRs would help reduce financing costs, stimulate consumption and investment, and support achievement of the full-year economic growth target.

source_text_zh: 【一年期、五年期LPR均下调10个基点】中国央行将一年期和五年期贷款市场报价利率（LPR）分别下调10个基点至3.55%和4.20%。
display_text_en: [One-Year and Five-Year LPRs Both Cut by 10 Basis Points] The People's Bank of China lowered the one-year and five-year loan prime rates (LPRs) by 10 basis points each, to 3.55% and 4.20%, respectively.

source_text_zh:
【李强：要围绕稳增长、稳就业、防风险等 抓紧实施一批针对性、组合性、协同性强的政策措施】中共中央政治局常委、国务院总理李强7月6日下午主持召开经济形势专家座谈会，听取专家学者对当前经济形势和做好经济工作的意见建议。

中共中央政治局常委、国务院副总理丁薛祥出席。

座谈会上，刘尚希、罗志恒、田轩、黄先海、袁海霞、秦海林、陆铭、赵伟等专家学者先后发言。大家认为，在复杂严峻的外部环境下，我国经济发展展现出巨大韧性，对我国经济发展前景应当充满信心。大家还就解决好经济运行中的问题提出了意见建议。

在认真听取专家学者们发言后，李强指出，今年以来，在以习近平同志为核心的党中央坚强领导下，我国经济呈现回升向好态势。同时要看到，世界政治经济形势错综复杂，对我国发展带来诸多影响。我们要全面、辩证、长远地研判当前经济形势，进一步保持战略定力，增强发展信心。

李强指出，我国正处在经济恢复和产业升级关键期，要坚持稳中求进工作总基调，完整、准确、全面贯彻新发展理念，加快构建新发展格局。要围绕稳增长、稳就业、防风险等，抓紧实施一批针对性、组合性、协同性强的政策措施。要围绕高质量发展首要任务，在转方式、调结构、增动能上下更大功夫。要建立健全政府与民营企业、外资企业等各类企业的常态化沟通交流机制，通过增强工作互动性来增强决策科学性。

李强希望广大专家学者发挥专业优势，把握客观规律和发展大势，多提建设性的意见建议，为推动高质量发展贡献智慧和力量。  （央视）
display_text_en:
[Li Qiang: Promptly Implement a Group of Highly Targeted, Combined, and Coordinated Policy Measures Focused on Stabilising Growth, Stabilising Employment, and Preventing Risks] Li Qiang, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Premier of the State Council, chaired a symposium with experts on the economic situation on the afternoon of July 6 to hear experts' and scholars' views and recommendations on the current economic situation and economic work.

Ding Xuexiang, a member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended.

At the symposium, experts and scholars including Liu Shangxi, Luo Zhiheng, Tian Xuan, Huang Xianhai, Yuan Haixia, Qin Hailin, Lu Ming, and Zhao Wei spoke in turn. They believed that, in a complex and severe external environment, China's economic development had demonstrated tremendous resilience and that there should be full confidence in the prospects for China's economic development. They also offered views and recommendations on resolving problems in economic operations.

After listening carefully to the experts and scholars, Li Qiang stated that, since the beginning of this year, under the strong leadership of the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, China's economy had shown a trend of recovery and improvement. At the same time, it was necessary to recognise that the global political and economic situation was complex and had many effects on China's development. The current economic situation must be assessed comprehensively, dialectically, and from a long-term perspective, while maintaining strategic resolve and strengthening confidence in development.

Li Qiang stated that China was at a critical stage of economic recovery and industrial upgrading. The general principle of pursuing progress while ensuring stability must be upheld, the new development philosophy implemented fully, accurately, and comprehensively, and creation of the new development pattern accelerated. A group of highly targeted, combined, and coordinated policy measures focused on stabilising growth, stabilising employment, and preventing risks must be implemented promptly. Greater efforts must be made to transform the development model, adjust the economic structure, and increase growth momentum, centred on the primary task of high-quality development. Regular communication and exchange mechanisms between the government and all kinds of enterprises, including private and foreign-invested enterprises, must be established and improved, and more scientific decision-making achieved by increasing interaction in work.

Li Qiang expressed the hope that experts and scholars would apply their professional strengths, understand objective laws and overall development trends, offer more constructive views and recommendations, and contribute their wisdom and strength to promoting high-quality development. (CCTV)

source_text_zh: 6月20日，中国人民银行下调贷款市场报价利率（LPR），1年期和5年期以上LPR均下降10个基点，分别为3.55%和4.2%，结束了连续9期未变的状态。这是自2022年8月以来首次调整。此次下调被视为支持实体经济的重要举措，有助于降低融资成本，提振市场信心。此外，降息将直接减少购房者的按揭还款压力，例如首套房贷款100万元、30年期的月供将减少约58元。分析人士预计后续可能推出更多稳增长政策，以促进有效需求修复。
display_text_en: On June 20, the People's Bank of China lowered the loan prime rates (LPRs). Both the one-year LPR and the LPR for terms of more than five years fell by 10 basis points, to 3.55% and 4.2%, respectively, ending nine consecutive periods without change. This was the first adjustment since August 2022. The reductions were regarded as an important measure to support the real economy, helping to lower financing costs and bolster market confidence. In addition, the rate cuts would directly reduce the pressure of mortgage repayments on homebuyers. For example, the monthly payment on a RMB 1 million, 30-year first-home mortgage would fall by approximately RMB 58. Analysts expected that more policies to stabilise growth might subsequently be introduced to promote a recovery in effective demand.
