source_text_zh: 央行于6月20日下调贷款市场报价利率（LPR），1年期LPR降至3.55%，5年期以上LPR降至4.2%，各下调10个基点。这次降息被认为是市场预期中的宽松政策，旨在提振经济和支持实体经济。分析指出，此次调整将降低住房贷款利率，减轻购房者负担，并可能提高购房消费信心。专家表示，在当前房地产市场中，尤其是弱二线及三四线城市的需求较弱，而一二线城市仍面临限购等政策限制，因此需要进一步优化相关政策以促进市场回暖。
display_text_en: On June 20, the central bank lowered the loan prime rates (LPRs), reducing the one-year LPR to 3.55% and the LPR for terms of more than five years to 4.2%, each down 10 basis points. The rate cuts were regarded as an accommodative policy move that the market had expected, intended to boost the economy and support the real economy. Analysis indicated that the adjustment would lower housing-loan rates, ease the burden on homebuyers, and might raise confidence in housing consumption. Experts said that, in the current property market, demand was weak particularly in weaker second-tier and third- and fourth-tier cities, while first- and second-tier cities still faced policy restrictions such as home-purchase limits. Relevant policies therefore needed to be optimised further to promote a market recovery.

source_text_zh: 【中证报头版：LPR下调10个基点，货币政策持续发力，更多政策工具有望推出，降准降息仍有空间】 中国人民银行授权全国银行间同业拆借中心6月20日公布，1年期贷款市场报价利率（LPR）为3.55%，5年期以上LPR为4.2%，均较上一期下降10个基点。专家认为，LPR下调将带动银行贷款利率下行，进而激发实体经济融资需求、提振房地产市场信心。为助力稳增长，货币政策有望继续加码，年内仍有降准、降息可能。
display_text_en: [China Securities Journal Front Page: LPRs Cut by 10 Basis Points as Monetary Policy Continues to Exert Force; More Policy Tools Expected, with Room Remaining for Cuts to the Reserve Requirement Ratio and Interest Rates] The National Interbank Funding Center, authorised by the People's Bank of China, announced on June 20 that the one-year loan prime rate (LPR) was 3.55% and the LPR for terms of more than five years was 4.2%, both down 10 basis points from the previous period. Experts believed that lower LPRs would drive bank lending rates lower, thereby stimulating financing demand in the real economy and bolstering confidence in the property market. To help stabilise growth, monetary policy was expected to be intensified further, with cuts to the reserve requirement ratio and interest rates still possible during the year.

source_text_zh: 【央行货币政策委员会：支持银行补充资本 共同维护金融市场的稳定发展】央行货币政策委员会召开2023年第二季度例会，会议指出，深化金融供给侧结构性改革，引导大银行服务重心下沉，推动中小银行聚焦主责主业，支持银行补充资本，共同维护金融市场的稳定发展。完善市场化利率形成和传导机制，优化央行政策利率体系，发挥存款利率市场化调整机制重要作用，发挥贷款市场报价利率改革效能和指导作用，推动企业融资和居民信贷成本稳中有降。
display_text_en: [Central Bank Monetary Policy Committee: Support Banks in Replenishing Capital and Jointly Safeguard the Stable Development of Financial Markets] The central bank's Monetary Policy Committee held its regular meeting for the second quarter of 2023. The meeting called for deepening supply-side structural reform in finance, guiding large banks to shift their service focus downwards, encouraging small and medium-sized banks to focus on their primary responsibilities and core businesses, supporting banks in replenishing capital, and jointly safeguarding the stable development of financial markets. It called for improving the market-oriented mechanisms for forming and transmitting interest rates, optimising the central bank's policy-rate system, giving full play to the important role of the market-oriented adjustment mechanism for deposit rates, giving full play to the effectiveness and guiding role of loan prime rate reform, and promoting steady declines in corporate financing and household credit costs.

source_text_zh: 【商务部：打造服务经济高质量发展和粤港澳大湾区的重要金融平台】商务部印发《自贸试验区重点工作清单（2023—2025年）》。在广东自贸试验区重点工作清单中提到，推进与港澳规则衔接、机制对接，深化与港澳在贸易、投资、金融、法律服务和职业资格互认等领域合作，促进内外贸法规制度衔接；推进广州期货交易所、大湾区债券平台、南沙国际金融岛、深港国际金融城等建设，依托现有交易场所开展农产品交易，打造服务经济高质量发展和粤港澳大湾区的重要金融平台；推进“大湾区组合港”“湾区一港通”建设，打造以南沙港、蛇口港为枢纽的一体化通关物流信息平台，提升各港口间物流和通关时效，实现港口群互联互通、协同发展。
display_text_en: [Ministry of Commerce: Create Important Financial Platforms Serving High-Quality Economic Development and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area] The Ministry of Commerce issued the List of Key Tasks for Pilot Free Trade Zones (2023-2025). The list of key tasks for the Guangdong Pilot Free Trade Zone mentioned advancing alignment of rules and linking of mechanisms with Hong Kong and Macao; deepening cooperation with Hong Kong and Macao in areas including trade, investment, finance, legal services, and mutual recognition of professional qualifications; and promoting alignment between domestic- and foreign-trade laws and institutions. It called for advancing construction of the Guangzhou Futures Exchange, the Greater Bay Area bond platform, Nansha International Financial Island, and Shenzhen-Hong Kong International Financial City; conducting agricultural-product trading through existing trading venues; and creating important financial platforms serving high-quality economic development and the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. It also called for advancing construction of the 'Greater Bay Area Combined Port' and 'Bay Area One-Port Connect' initiatives; creating an integrated customs-clearance logistics information platform with Nansha Port and Shekou Port as hubs; improving logistics and customs-clearance efficiency among ports; and achieving interconnection and coordinated development of the port cluster.

source_text_zh: 6月15日，中国央行宣布为维护银行体系流动性，开展2370亿元中期借贷便利（MLF）操作和20亿元逆回购操作，其中MLF利率下调10个基点至2.65%。此次降息结束了连续9个月的保持不变。市场分析认为，此次政策性降息释放了稳增长信号，将刺激实体经济融资需求，并加快银行信贷投放节奏。此外，由于近期存款利率下降，预计本月贷款市场报价利率（LPR）可能会首次调整，有望下调5至10个基点，特别是与房贷相关的5年期LPR降幅可能更大。整体来看，政策变化旨在提振市场信心并促进经济平稳发展。
display_text_en: On June 15, the People's Bank of China announced that, to maintain liquidity in the banking system, it would conduct a RMB 237 billion medium-term lending facility (MLF) operation and a RMB 2 billion reverse-repurchase operation, with the MLF rate lowered by 10 basis points to 2.65%. This rate cut ended nine consecutive months without change. Market analysis indicated that the policy-rate cut sent a signal of stabilising growth, would stimulate financing demand in the real economy, and would accelerate the pace of bank lending. In addition, because deposit rates had recently declined, the loan prime rates (LPRs) were expected to be adjusted for the first time this month and might fall by 5 to 10 basis points. The reduction in the five-year LPR, which is particularly related to mortgages, might be larger. Overall, the policy changes were intended to bolster market confidence and promote stable economic development.

source_text_zh: 【证监会启动公募基金费率改革，涉及六方面内容】 从监管部门获悉，证监会启动公募基金费率改革工作，主要包括六方面内容，一是坚持以固定费率产品为主；二是推出更多浮动费率产品。前期证监会已受理一批与投资者持有时间挂钩的浮动费率产品。近日，证监会正式接收11只浮动费率产品募集申请，包括与基金规模挂钩、与基金业绩挂钩两类。三是降低主动权益类基金费率水平。四是降低公募基金证券交易佣金费率。相关改革措施涉及修改相关法规，预计将于2023年底前完成。五是规范公募基金销售环节收费。预计于2024年底前完成。六是完善公募基金行业费率披露机制。（证券时报）
display_text_en: [CSRC Launches Reform of Public-Fund Fee Rates, Covering Six Areas] It was learned from the regulatory authorities that the China Securities Regulatory Commission had launched reform of public-fund fee rates, mainly covering six areas. First, products with fixed fee rates would remain the principal type. Second, more products with floating fee rates would be introduced. The CSRC had previously accepted a group of floating-fee-rate products linked to investors' holding periods. Recently, it formally received fundraising applications for 11 floating-fee-rate products in two categories: those linked to fund size and those linked to fund performance. Third, fee-rate levels for actively managed equity funds would be reduced. Fourth, securities-trading commission rates for public funds would be reduced. The related reform measures involved amendments to relevant regulations and were expected to be completed before the end of 2023. Fifth, charges in the sale of public funds would be standardised. This was expected to be completed before the end of 2024. Sixth, the fee-rate disclosure mechanism for the public-fund industry would be improved. (Securities Times)

source_text_zh: 6月13日，中国人民银行将7天期逆回购操作利率下调10个基点至1.9%，同时其他期限的利率也进行了相应下调。这一降息措施被视为逆周期调节的积极信号，可能推动权益市场反弹，并改善市场预期以促进内需增长和实体经济发展。专家认为，此次降息有助于修复居民和企业的资产负债表，助力经济复苏，并为地方债务及金融机构改革提供合理流动性环境。随着托底性政策的出台，预计库存周期将逐步恢复，从低迷阶段转向复苏阶段，特别看好TMT板块和可选消费的估值修复行情。
display_text_en: On June 13, the People's Bank of China lowered the seven-day reverse-repurchase operation rate by 10 basis points to 1.9%, while rates for other maturities were also reduced accordingly. This rate-cut measure was regarded as a positive signal of countercyclical adjustment that might drive a rebound in the equity market and improve market expectations in order to promote growth in domestic demand and development of the real economy. Experts believed the rate cut would help repair household and corporate balance sheets, support economic recovery, and provide an environment of reasonable liquidity for local-debt and financial-institution reforms. With the introduction of policies providing a floor, the inventory cycle was expected to recover gradually and shift from a depressed phase to a recovery phase. The valuation-recovery opportunities in the TMT sector and discretionary consumption were viewed particularly favourably.

source_text_zh: 美联储主席鲍威尔在周三的新闻发布会上表示，几乎所有决策者认为今年应进一步加息。尽管美联储决定维持关键利率不变，打破了14个月内连续10次加息的纪录，但委员会一致致力于将通胀率降至2%。鲍威尔指出，今年降息不合适，并强调经济预计将持续温和增长，同时劳动力市场压力仍然存在。他提到将在7月会议上根据最新数据再做决策，并指出供应链状况正在改善，但服务业通胀的降低迹象仍较早。鲍威尔还表示，美联储对商业房地产的贷款风险保持关注，并承认当前信贷紧缩影响评估仍为时尚早。
display_text_en: Federal Reserve Chair Powell said at a press conference on Wednesday that almost all policymakers believed interest rates should be raised further this year. Although the Federal Reserve decided to keep its key rate unchanged, breaking a run of ten consecutive increases over 14 months, the committee was unanimously committed to reducing inflation to 2%. Powell said rate cuts would not be appropriate this year and emphasised that the economy was expected to continue growing moderately while labour-market pressures persisted. He said a further decision would be made at the July meeting based on the latest data and noted that supply-chain conditions were improving, although signs of lower services inflation were still at an early stage. Powell also said the Federal Reserve remained attentive to lending risks in commercial property and acknowledged that it was still too early to assess the effects of the current credit tightening.

source_text_zh: 据中证报，九个月按兵不动后，中国贷款市场报价利率（LPR）再次调降，各地房贷利率也跟随调整。6月20日，记者获悉，北京、深圳、苏州等地多家银行已迅速下调商业贷款利率。其中，苏州首套房贷款利率已低至4%。郑州的首套房贷款利率在此前降至3.8...
display_text_en: According to China Securities Journal, after nine months without action, China's loan prime rates (LPRs) were reduced again, and mortgage rates around the country were adjusted accordingly. On June 20, reporters learned that several banks in Beijing, Shenzhen, Suzhou, and other places had rapidly lowered commercial mortgage rates. Among them, the interest rate on first-home mortgages in Suzhou had fallen as low as 4%. The first-home mortgage rate in Zhengzhou had previously fallen to 3.8...

source_text_zh: 中国人民银行、国家金融监督管理总局：对于房地产企业开发贷款、信托贷款等存量融资，在保证债权安全的前提下，鼓励金融机构与房地产企业基于商业性原则自主协商，积极通过存量贷款展期、调整还款安排等方式予以支持，促进项目完工交付。2024年12月31日前到期的，可以允许超出原规定多展期1年，可不调整贷款分类，报送征信系统的贷款分类与之保持一致。
display_text_en: People's Bank of China and National Financial Regulatory Administration: For existing financing of property companies, such as property-development loans and trust loans, financial institutions and property companies are encouraged, on the basis of commercial principles and provided creditor claims are kept secure, to negotiate independently and actively provide support through methods including extensions of existing loans and adjustments to repayment arrangements, in order to promote project completion and delivery. For financing maturing before December 31, 2024, an extension of one additional year beyond the period originally prescribed may be permitted without adjusting the loan classification, and the loan classification submitted to the credit-reporting system may remain consistent with it.

source_text_zh: 【5年期以上LPR下降10个基点 100万元房贷30年减少2.1万元】今日，最新一期贷款市场报价利率（LPR）出炉，五年期LPR下调至4.2%，此前为4.3%。如以商贷额度100万元、贷款30年、等额本息还款方式计算，此次LPR下降10个基点，月供减少58.54元，累积30年月供减少2.1万元。目前，全国统一首套住房商业性个人住房贷款利率下限为4.1%，此次5年期LPR下调10BP后，统一房贷利率下限有望突破4%关口。
display_text_en: [LPR for Terms of More Than Five Years Falls by 10 Basis Points; Payments on a RMB 1 Million, 30-Year Mortgage Fall by RMB 21,000] The latest loan prime rates (LPRs) were announced today, with the five-year LPR lowered to 4.2% from 4.3%. For a commercial mortgage of RMB 1 million over 30 years with equal principal-and-interest repayments, the 10-basis-point decline in the LPR reduces the monthly payment by RMB 58.54 and cumulative payments over 30 years by RMB 21,000. At present, the nationally unified floor for the interest rate on commercial personal mortgages for first homes is 4.1%. Following this 10-basis-point reduction in the five-year LPR, the unified mortgage-rate floor is expected to fall below the 4% threshold.

source_text_zh: 【李强：中国经济回升向好的态势明显 全年有望实现5%左右的预期增长目标】国务院总理李强27日上午在天津出席2023年夏季达沃斯论坛开幕式并致辞。李强表示，在未来更长时间里，中国将继续为世界经济复苏和增长提供强大动能。中国仍然是世界上最大的发展中国家，我们有14亿多人口，人均经济指标和人民生活水平还不高，发展还不平衡、不充分，但这也是中国发展的潜力和空间所在。我们正在认真贯彻新发展理念，加快构建新发展格局，努力实现高质量发展。我们将在扩大内需潜力、激发市场活力、推动城乡区域协调发展、加快发展方式绿色转型、推动高水平对外开放等方面，推出更多务实有效的举措。这些举措正在发挥效应，从今年来的情况看，中国经济回升向好的态势明显，一季度同比增长4.5%，预计二季度增速将快于一季度，全年有望实现5%左右的预期增长目标。一些国际组织和机构也调高了今年中国经济增长预期，显示了对中国发展前景的信心。我们完全有信心、有能力，在一个较长的周期内，推动中国经济在高质量发展轨道上行稳致远。这将不断扩大市场规模、创造合作机会，为世界经济复苏和增长提供源源不断的动力，同时也为各国投资者提供互利共赢的合作机遇。
display_text_en: [Li Qiang: The Trend of China's Economic Recovery and Improvement Is Clear, and the Expected Growth Target of About 5% Is Likely to Be Achieved for the Full Year] Premier Li Qiang attended the opening ceremony of the 2023 Summer Davos Forum in Tianjin on the morning of the 27th and delivered a speech. Li said that, over a longer period in the future, China would continue to provide powerful momentum for global economic recovery and growth. China remains the world's largest developing country. We have a population of more than 1.4 billion, while per-capita economic indicators and people's living standards are not yet high, and development remains unbalanced and inadequate; however, therein also lie China's development potential and room for growth. We are earnestly implementing the new development philosophy, accelerating creation of a new development pattern, and working to achieve high-quality development. We will introduce more practical and effective measures in areas including expanding the potential of domestic demand, stimulating market vitality, promoting coordinated urban-rural and regional development, accelerating the green transformation of the development model, and promoting high-standard opening up. These measures are taking effect. Judging from developments so far this year, the trend of China's economic recovery and improvement is clear. The economy grew by 4.5% year on year in the first quarter, growth in the second quarter is expected to be faster than in the first quarter, and the expected growth target of about 5% is likely to be achieved for the full year. Some international organisations and institutions have also raised their forecasts for China's economic growth this year, demonstrating confidence in China's development prospects. We have every confidence and ability to promote the steady and sustained progress of China's economy along the path of high-quality development over a relatively long cycle. This will continuously expand the size of the market, create opportunities for cooperation, and provide an unending source of momentum for global economic recovery and growth, while also providing investors from all countries with opportunities for mutually beneficial and win-win cooperation.

source_text_zh: 6月20日，贷款市场报价利率（LPR）结束连续9个月不变，1年期和5年期LPR同步下调10个基点。此次下调将促使银行贷款利率进一步下降，激发实体经济的融资需求，并支持住房需求。业内预计未来宏观政策可能会继续加强，财政及准财政工具的使用有望加大。
display_text_en: On June 20, the loan prime rates (LPRs) ended nine consecutive months without change, with both the one-year and five-year LPRs lowered by 10 basis points. The reductions would prompt bank lending rates to decline further, stimulate financing demand in the real economy, and support housing demand. Industry participants expected that macro policies might continue to be strengthened in the future and that the use of fiscal and quasi-fiscal tools was expected to increase.

source_text_zh: 【分析师：6月LPR报价有可能出现非对称下调】继公开市场逆回购、各期限常备借贷便利操作（SLF）后，中期借贷便利操作（MLF）也跟随下调10个基点。东方金诚首席宏观分析师王青认为，MLF操作利率是LPR报价的定价基础，6月MLF操作利率下调后，当月两个品种的LPR报价也将跟进下调。“考虑到当前企业贷款利率已处于历史低点，且明显低于居民房贷利率，加之近期楼市再度转弱，我们判断6月1年期LPR报价和5年期以上LPR报价有可能出现非对称下调，即1年期LPR报价可能下调0.05个百分点，5年期以上LPR报价下调0.15个百分点。这将带动企业和居民贷款利率、特别是居民房贷利率更大幅下调。” （每经）
display_text_en: [Analyst: LPR Quotations May Be Reduced Asymmetrically in June] Following open-market reverse-repurchase operations and standing lending facility (SLF) operations of various maturities, the medium-term lending facility (MLF) operation rate was also lowered by 10 basis points. Wang Qing, Chief Macro Analyst at Golden Credit Rating, believed that the MLF operation rate was the pricing basis for LPR quotations and that, after the MLF operation rate was lowered in June, the two LPR quotations for the month would also be lowered accordingly. 'Considering that current corporate lending rates are already at historical lows and are clearly below household mortgage rates, together with the renewed weakening of the property market recently, we judge that the one-year LPR quotation and the LPR quotation for terms of more than five years may be lowered asymmetrically in June. Specifically, the one-year LPR quotation may be lowered by 0.05 percentage points and the LPR quotation for terms of more than five years by 0.15 percentage points. This will drive larger reductions in corporate and household lending rates, particularly household mortgage rates.' (National Business Daily)

source_text_zh: 李强主持召开国务院常务会议，研究推动经济持续回升的一系列政策措施。
display_text_en: Li Qiang chaired a State Council executive meeting to study a series of policy measures to promote a sustained economic recovery.

source_text_zh: 6月13日，央行下调了7天期逆回购利率、常备借贷便利利率和MLF操作利率各10个基点，这是自2022年8月以来首次降息。央行行长易纲强调将加强逆周期调节，全力支持实体经济。这一系列措施旨在提升市场信心，稳定经济，并增强银行的信贷投放能力。同时，主要金融机构也开始下调存款利率，并调整消费贷款利率至最低3.65%。最新数据显示，中国经济恢复向好迹象明显，但市场需求仍显不足，需要进一步推动高质量发展。国际金融机构已上调中国2023年GDP增速预期，央行的支持政策为促进经济复苏提供了有力保障。
display_text_en: On June 13, the central bank lowered the seven-day reverse-repurchase rate, the standing lending facility rate, and the MLF operation rate by 10 basis points each. These were the first interest-rate cuts since August 2022. Central-bank Governor Yi Gang stressed that countercyclical adjustment would be strengthened and full support provided to the real economy. This series of measures was intended to strengthen market confidence, stabilise the economy, and enhance banks' capacity to issue credit. At the same time, major financial institutions also began lowering deposit rates and adjusted consumer-loan rates to as low as 3.65%. The latest data showed clear signs of recovery and improvement in China's economy, although market demand remained insufficient and high-quality development needed to be promoted further. International financial institutions had raised their forecasts for China's 2023 GDP growth, and the central bank's supportive policies provided strong safeguards for promoting economic recovery.

source_text_zh: 据中证报，专家认为，LPR下调将带动银行贷款利率下行，进而激发实体经济融资需求、提振房地产市场信心。为助力稳增长，货币政策有望继续加码，年内仍有降准、降息可能。
display_text_en: According to China Securities Journal, experts believed that reductions in the LPRs would drive bank lending rates lower, thereby stimulating financing demand in the real economy and bolstering confidence in the property market. To help stabilise growth, monetary policy was expected to be intensified further, with cuts to the reserve requirement ratio and interest rates still possible during the year.

source_text_zh: 央行于15日宣布进行2370亿元的中期借贷便利（MLF）操作，利率下调至2.65%，并开展20亿元逆回购操作，利率保持在1.90%。业内普遍预计，下周的贷款市场报价利率（LPR）将随之下调，有助于稳增长和提振市场信心。近期多家银行下调存款挂牌利率，市场关注6月降息的可能性。专家表示，预计1年期LPR将下调5个基点，而5年期以上LPR可能下调15个基点。此外，央行行长易纲强调要继续实施稳健货币政策，以支持实体经济发展。
display_text_en: On the 15th, the central bank announced that it would conduct a RMB 237 billion medium-term lending facility (MLF) operation, with the rate lowered to 2.65%, and a RMB 2 billion reverse-repurchase operation, with the rate kept at 1.90%. The industry generally expected the loan prime rates (LPRs) to be reduced accordingly the following week, helping to stabilise growth and bolster market confidence. Several banks had recently lowered their posted deposit rates, and the market was watching the possibility of interest-rate cuts in June. Experts said the one-year LPR was expected to fall by 5 basis points, while the LPR for terms of more than five years might fall by 15 basis points. In addition, central-bank Governor Yi Gang stressed the need to continue implementing prudent monetary policy to support development of the real economy.

source_text_zh: 在连续9期未变后，国内贷款市场报价利率（LPR）于6月20日首次下调，1年期LPR为3.55%，5年期以上LPR为4.2%，均下降10个基点。此调整得益于央行近期频繁降息，为LPR下调创造了条件。分析人士认为，LPR的降低有助于加强逆周期调节，促进需求恢复，并可能刺激信贷需求及增强市场信心。此外，未来货币政策仍有进一步操作空间，下半年可能继续降息或降准。
display_text_en: After remaining unchanged for nine consecutive periods, China's loan prime rates (LPRs) were lowered for the first time on June 20. The one-year LPR was 3.55% and the LPR for terms of more than five years was 4.2%, both down 10 basis points. The adjustment benefited from the central bank's frequent recent interest-rate cuts, which created conditions for lower LPRs. Analysts believed the LPR reductions would help strengthen countercyclical adjustment, promote a recovery in demand, and might stimulate credit demand and enhance market confidence. In addition, monetary policy still had further room for action, and interest rates or the reserve requirement ratio might be reduced further in the second half of the year.

source_text_zh: 美联储于周四凌晨宣布，将联邦基金利率目标区间维持在5.00%-5.25%不变，这是自去年3月以来的首次暂停加息。美联储表示，此次决定使委员会能够评估更多数据，并强调将继续致力于将通胀率恢复至2%的目标。根据最新点阵图，2023年底的利率预期中值上调至5.6%，暗示仍有可能加息两次。同时，美联储下调了2024年和2025年的GDP增长预期，并对失业率和个人消费支出（PCE）通胀预期进行了相应调整，预计2023年PCE通胀为3.2%。
display_text_en: In the early hours of Thursday, the Federal Reserve announced that it would maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 5.00%-5.25%, the first pause in rate increases since March last year. The Federal Reserve said the decision would allow the committee to assess more data and stressed that it would remain committed to returning inflation to the 2% target. According to the latest dot plot, the median interest-rate projection for the end of 2023 was raised to 5.6%, suggesting that two further rate increases remained possible. At the same time, the Federal Reserve lowered its GDP growth forecasts for 2024 and 2025 and made corresponding adjustments to its forecasts for unemployment and personal consumption expenditures (PCE) inflation, with PCE inflation expected to be 3.2% in 2023.

source_text_zh: 财政部、税务总局和工业和信息化部近日发布公告，延续新能源汽车车辆购置税减免政策至2027年底，其中2024年至2025年期间对新能源乘用车免征购置税，每辆最高免税额为3万元；2026年至2027年期间减半征收，每辆最高减税额为1.5万元。预计该政策实施后，2024年至2027年的累计减免规模将达5200亿元。自2014年以来，该政策已多次延续，有效促进了新能源汽车的市场发展。今年前五个月，新能源汽车产销均实现显著增长。相关专家认为，此政策将持续刺激汽车消费并推动燃油车向新能源车转型。
display_text_en: The Ministry of Finance, the State Taxation Administration, and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology recently issued an announcement extending the vehicle purchase-tax relief policy for new-energy vehicles through the end of 2027. From 2024 to 2025, new-energy passenger vehicles will be exempt from vehicle purchase tax, with a maximum exemption of RMB 30,000 per vehicle; from 2026 to 2027, half the tax will be levied, with a maximum tax reduction of RMB 15,000 per vehicle. Following implementation, the policy is expected to provide cumulative relief of RMB 520 billion from 2024 to 2027. Since 2014, the policy has been extended several times and has effectively promoted the market development of new-energy vehicles. In the first five months of this year, both production and sales of new-energy vehicles achieved significant growth. Relevant experts believed the policy would continue to stimulate automobile consumption and promote the transition from fuel vehicles to new-energy vehicles.

source_text_zh: 在经历前期下跌后，上周A股市场情绪明显回暖，沪深300指数、中证500指数和创业板指数的涨幅分别为3.30%、2.30%和5.93%。市场活跃度提升，日均成交额超过1万亿元，北向资金净买入143.91亿元。机构分析认为，经济预期和政策信心修正是推动市场反弹的主要因素。在央行降息和政策支持的背景下，预计未来市场风险偏好将持续回升。此外，下半年A股盈利修复可能延续，中金公司对2023年市场持中性偏积极态度。尽管短期内仍存在波动，但外资流入及政策环境改善或将支撑市场上涨。
display_text_en: After earlier declines, sentiment in the A-share market improved markedly last week. The CSI 300 Index, CSI 500 Index, and ChiNext Index rose by 3.30%, 2.30%, and 5.93%, respectively. Market activity increased, with average daily turnover exceeding RMB 1 trillion and net purchases through northbound trading of RMB 14.391 billion. Institutional analysis indicated that revisions to economic expectations and policy confidence were the main factors driving the market rebound. Against the background of central-bank interest-rate cuts and policy support, market risk appetite was expected to continue rising in the future. In addition, the recovery in A-share earnings might continue in the second half of the year, and CICC held a neutral-to-positive view of the market for 2023. Although volatility remained possible in the short term, foreign capital inflows and an improved policy environment might support market gains.

source_text_zh: 【LPR可能采取非对称降息】随着MLF降息落地，多位人士也预计，6月LPR随之下调将成为大概率事件。正如仲量联行大中华区首席经济学家及研究部总监庞溟所说，考虑到目前宏观经济修复的形态、节奏与力度，社会有效需求需要包括货币政策在内的宏观政策继续呵护与刺激，后续1年期和5年期LPR非对称下降的概率较高。植信投资研究院高级研究员王运金提道，“我们预计6月LPR可能会非对称下调，其中1年期下调5个基点、5年期下调10-15个基点；以LPR为基准的存量与增量贷款利率将不同程度下行，推动实体经济融资成本继续下行，加快刺激国内需求”。（北京商报）
display_text_en: [LPRs May Be Cut Asymmetrically] With the MLF rate cut implemented, several people also expected that a corresponding reduction in the LPRs in June would be highly probable. As Pang Ming, Chief Economist and Head of Research for Greater China at JLL, said, considering the form, pace, and strength of the current macroeconomic recovery, effective social demand needed continued support and stimulus from macro policies, including monetary policy, and the probability of asymmetric declines in the one-year and five-year LPRs was relatively high. Wang Yunjin, Senior Researcher at the Zhixin Investment Research Institute, said: 'We expect the LPRs may be lowered asymmetrically in June, with the one-year rate down 5 basis points and the five-year rate down 10-15 basis points. Interest rates on existing and incremental loans benchmarked to the LPRs will fall to varying degrees, driving further declines in financing costs in the real economy and accelerating the stimulation of domestic demand.' (Beijing Business Today)

source_text_zh: 据上证报，财政部等部门联合发布《关于延续和优化新能源汽车车辆购置税减免政策的公告》明确：2024-2025年，购置新能源汽车免征车辆购置税；2026-2027年，购置税减半征收。对此，作为中国新能源造车新势力代表的蔚来和理想汽车迅速给予积极回应...
display_text_en: According to Shanghai Securities News, the Ministry of Finance and other departments jointly issued the Announcement on Extending and Optimising the Vehicle Purchase-Tax Relief Policy for New-Energy Vehicles. It specified that purchases of new-energy vehicles in 2024-2025 would be exempt from vehicle purchase tax, while purchases in 2026-2027 would be subject to half the tax. In response, NIO and Li Auto, representatives of China's new generation of new-energy vehicle manufacturers, quickly responded positively...

source_text_zh: 6月21日，财政部、税务总局和工信部联合发布公告，决定将新能源汽车购置税减免政策延续至2027年末。具体措施为：2024年1月1日至2025年12月31日期间购置的新能源汽车免征车辆购置税，每辆新能源乘用车免税额不超过3万元；而在2026年1月1日至2027年12月31日期间购置的新能源汽车则减半征收车辆购置税，每辆减税额不超过1.5万元。这项政策旨在支持新能源汽车产业发展和促进汽车消费，预计将在2024至2027年期间累计减免车辆购置税约5200亿元。
display_text_en: On June 21, the Ministry of Finance, the State Taxation Administration, and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology jointly issued an announcement deciding to extend the vehicle purchase-tax relief policy for new-energy vehicles through the end of 2027. The specific measures are as follows: new-energy vehicles purchased from January 1, 2024 to December 31, 2025 will be exempt from vehicle purchase tax, with the exemption for each new-energy passenger vehicle not exceeding RMB 30,000; new-energy vehicles purchased from January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2027 will be subject to half the vehicle purchase tax, with the tax reduction for each vehicle not exceeding RMB 15,000. The policy is intended to support development of the new-energy vehicle industry and promote automobile consumption, and is expected to provide cumulative vehicle purchase-tax relief of approximately RMB 520 billion from 2024 to 2027.

source_text_zh: 自6月以来，中国进入新一轮降息周期，涵盖存款、OMO/MLF和LPR等多个方面。尽管全球大多数国家加息，中国选择降息的原因在于国内经济低迷和CPI处于低位，急需通过降息刺激经济。同时，中国实现了货币政策独立性，可以在美联储加息时选择降息，这得益于放弃固定汇率和保持一定的资本账户管制。然而，随着利率接近底部，继续降息的意义减弱，因此预计下半年最多再降1-2次。若经济复苏动力恢复，则可能迎来新的加息周期。
display_text_en: Since June, China has entered a new interest-rate-cut cycle covering deposits, open-market operations and the MLF, LPRs, and other areas. Although most countries worldwide were raising interest rates, China chose to cut them because of the weak domestic economy and low CPI, making rate cuts urgently necessary to stimulate the economy. At the same time, China had achieved monetary-policy independence and could choose to cut interest rates while the Federal Reserve raised them, owing to the abandonment of a fixed exchange rate and the maintenance of a degree of capital-account control. However, as interest rates approached their lower bound, the value of further cuts diminished, and no more than one or two further reductions were therefore expected in the second half of the year. If the momentum of economic recovery returned, a new interest-rate-increase cycle might begin.

source_text_zh: 国务院于6月29日发布通知，提出在有条件的自由贸易试验区和自由贸易港推进制度型开放的若干措施。通知指出，除了特定的新金融服务外，如果允许中资金融机构开展某项新服务，则试点地区的外资金融机构也应被允许提供同类服务。金融管理部门将根据职权决定哪些机构可以开展此项新服务，并要求获得许可。同时，管理部门需在合理期限内作出决定，仅可因审慎理由拒绝许可。
display_text_en: On June 29, the State Council issued a notice proposing several measures to advance institutional opening up in eligible pilot free trade zones and free trade ports. The notice stated that, except for specified new financial services, if Chinese-funded financial institutions were permitted to provide a new service, foreign-funded financial institutions in the pilot regions should also be permitted to provide the same type of service. Financial regulators would decide, within the scope of their authority, which institutions could provide the new service and would require them to obtain approval. At the same time, regulators must make a decision within a reasonable period and could refuse approval only for prudential reasons.

source_text_zh: 【国家发改委主任郑栅洁：破除制约民营企业公平参与市场竞争的制度障碍 进一步扩大民间投资准入范围】国家发展改革委党组书记、主任郑栅洁撰文指出，要综合施策扩大需求。把实施扩大内需战略同深化供给侧结构性改革有机结合起来。促进消费持续恢复，持续提升传统消费，加快培育新型消费，不断壮大消费热点。积极扩大有效投资，优化中央预算内投资结构，集中力量办大事、办难事、办急事，有力有序推进“十四五”规划102项重大工程建设；破除制约民营企业公平参与市场竞争的制度障碍，进一步扩大民间投资准入范围，鼓励和吸引更多民间资本参与国家重大工程项目和补短板项目建设。
display_text_en: [NDRC Chairman Zheng Shanjie: Remove Institutional Obstacles Restricting Private Enterprises' Fair Participation in Market Competition and Further Expand Market Access for Private Investment] Zheng Shanjie, Secretary of the Leading Party Members Group and Chairman of the National Development and Reform Commission, wrote that a combination of measures must be used to expand demand. Implementation of the strategy to expand domestic demand must be organically combined with deepening supply-side structural reform. The sustained recovery of consumption must be promoted, traditional consumption continuously upgraded, new forms of consumption cultivated more rapidly, and consumption hotspots continuously expanded. Effective investment must be actively expanded, the structure of investment from the central budget optimised, and resources concentrated on major, difficult, and urgent matters. Construction of the 102 major projects in the 14th Five-Year Plan must be advanced forcefully and in an orderly manner; institutional obstacles restricting private enterprises' fair participation in market competition must be removed; the scope of market access for private investment further expanded; and more private capital encouraged and attracted to participate in national major projects and projects addressing weak links.

source_text_zh: 【LPR“降息”落地 多地银行跟进下调房贷利率】 九个月按兵不动后，中国贷款市场报价利率（LPR）再次调降，各地房贷利率也跟随调整。6月20日，记者获悉，北京、深圳、苏州等地多家银行已迅速下调商业贷款利率。其中，苏州首套房贷款利率已低至4%。郑州的首套房贷款利率在此前降至3.8%之后，有望进一步降至3.7%。（中证报）
display_text_en: [LPR 'Rate Cuts' Implemented as Banks in Many Locations Follow with Mortgage-Rate Reductions] After nine months without action, China's loan prime rates (LPRs) were reduced again, and mortgage rates around the country were adjusted accordingly. On June 20, reporters learned that several banks in Beijing, Shenzhen, Suzhou, and other places had rapidly lowered commercial mortgage rates. Among them, the interest rate on first-home mortgages in Suzhou had fallen as low as 4%. After previously falling to 3.8%, the first-home mortgage rate in Zhengzhou was expected to fall further to 3.7%. (China Securities Journal)

source_text_zh:
2023年6月20日，中国人民银行公布的贷款市场报价利率（LPR）首次下调，1年期LPR为3.55%，5年期以上为4.2%，均下调10个基点。分析师王青指出，此次下调是为了应对经济修复动力不足和房地产市场转弱，并预计将促使企业和居民贷款利率进一步下降，从而提振经济信心。展望未来，王青认为在温和物价水平的情况下，政策性降息还有空间，可能会继续引导房贷利率走低。

与此同时，英国2年期国债收益率升破5%，创近15年来新高，预计英国央行将在即将到来的决议中再加息25基点，以应对顽固通胀。而德国5月生产者价格指数（PPI）数据显示，同比上涨1%，环比下降1.4%，显示出通胀逐步缓解，但德国经济依然面临技术性衰退，复苏前景较为黯淡。
display_text_en:
On June 20, 2023, the loan prime rates (LPRs) announced by the People's Bank of China were lowered for the first time. The one-year LPR was 3.55% and the LPR for terms of more than five years was 4.2%, both down 10 basis points. Analyst Wang Qing noted that the reductions were intended to address insufficient momentum in the economic recovery and a weakening property market, and expected them to prompt further declines in corporate and household lending rates, thereby boosting economic confidence. Looking ahead, Wang believed there was still room for policy-rate cuts while price levels remained moderate, and that mortgage rates might continue to be guided lower.

Meanwhile, the yield on the UK's two-year government bond rose above 5%, a nearly 15-year high. The Bank of England was expected to raise interest rates by another 25 basis points at its forthcoming decision to address persistent inflation. Germany's producer price index (PPI) data for May showed a year-on-year rise of 1% and a month-on-month decline of 1.4%, indicating that inflation was gradually easing. However, the German economy still faced a technical recession, and its recovery prospects were relatively bleak.

source_text_zh: 7月3日，商务部和海关总署发布公告，从2023年8月1日起对镓、锗相关物项实施出口管制。公告指出，镓相关物项包括金属镓、氮化镓、氧化镓等，而锗相关物项包括金属锗、磷锗锌、二氧化锗等。未经许可不得出口这些物项，出口经营者需申请许可证，并可面临行政处罚或刑事责任。此举旨在维护国家安全和利益。
display_text_en: On July 3, the Ministry of Commerce and the General Administration of Customs issued an announcement imposing export controls on gallium- and germanium-related items from August 1, 2023. The announcement stated that gallium-related items included gallium metal, gallium nitride, and gallium oxide, among others, while germanium-related items included germanium metal, zinc germanium phosphide, and germanium dioxide, among others. These items may not be exported without permission; export operators must apply for licences and may face administrative penalties or criminal liability. The measure was intended to safeguard national security and interests.

source_text_zh: 财政部、税务总局和工业和信息化部联合发布公告，延续新能源汽车购置税减免政策至2027年，具体为2024年至2025年免征车辆购置税，2026年至2027年减半征收。此举旨在促进新能源汽车产业发展，并于近年来相继出台多项刺激消费政策，以提升市场信心。预计新政策实施后，未来四年内累计减免税额将达5200亿元。同时，为应对动力蓄电池的回收利用问题，相关部门正加强规范管理与技术创新，以支持可持续发展。
display_text_en: The Ministry of Finance, the State Taxation Administration, and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology jointly issued an announcement extending the vehicle purchase-tax relief policy for new-energy vehicles through 2027. Specifically, vehicle purchase tax will be waived from 2024 to 2025 and halved from 2026 to 2027. The measure is intended to promote development of the new-energy vehicle industry and follows the successive introduction of several policies in recent years to stimulate consumption and strengthen market confidence. Following implementation of the new policy, cumulative tax relief over the next four years is expected to reach RMB 520 billion. At the same time, to address the recycling and reuse of power batteries, the relevant departments are strengthening standardised management and technological innovation to support sustainable development.

source_text_zh: 6月20日，中国人民银行公布最新一期LPR（贷款市场报价利率），1年期LPR下调至3.55%，5年期以上LPR下调至4.2%，均较前值降低10个基点，结束了自去年9月份以来的持平状态。这次调整受到央行在6月15日下调MLF（中期借贷便利）利率的影响。专家认为，此次LPR降息将有助于加强逆周期调节、促进企业投资和居民消费，从而刺激经济增长。此外，购房者将因房贷压力减轻而受益。分析人士预测，下半年可能继续降息和降准，以进一步推动房地产行业复苏和经济发展。
display_text_en: On June 20, the People's Bank of China announced the latest loan prime rates (LPRs), lowering the one-year LPR to 3.55% and the LPR for terms of more than five years to 4.2%, both down 10 basis points from their previous values and ending the period of unchanged rates since September last year. The adjustment was influenced by the central bank's reduction in the medium-term lending facility (MLF) rate on June 15. Experts believed the LPR cuts would help strengthen countercyclical adjustment and promote corporate investment and household consumption, thereby stimulating economic growth. In addition, homebuyers would benefit from reduced mortgage pressure. Analysts predicted that interest rates and the reserve requirement ratio might be reduced further in the second half of the year to promote further recovery in the property industry and economic development.

source_text_zh: 中国6月新增人民币贷款3.05万亿，预估为23185亿元，前值为13628亿元。
display_text_en: China's new renminbi loans totalled RMB 3.05 trillion in June, compared with an estimate of RMB 2.3185 trillion and a previous value of RMB 1.3628 trillion.

source_text_zh: 中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席、中央全面深化改革委员会主任习近平7月11日下午主持召开中央全面深化改革委员会第二次会议，审议通过了《关于建设更高水平开放型经济新体制促进构建新发展格局的意见》《深化农村改革实施方案》《关于推动能耗双控逐步转向碳排放双控的意见》《关于高等学校、科研院所薪酬制度改革试点的意见》《关于进一步深化石油天然气市场体系改革提升国家油气安全保障能力的实施意见》《关于深化电力体制改革加快构建新型电力系统的指导意见》。习近平在主持会议时强调，建设更高水平开放型经济新体制是我们主动作为以开放促改革、促发展的战略举措，要围绕服务构建新发展格局，以制度型开放为重点，聚焦投资、贸易、金融、创新等对外交流合作的重点领域深化体制机制改革，完善配套政策措施，积极主动把我国对外开放提高到新水平。要锚定实现农业农村现代化、建设农业强国的战略目标，以处理好农民和土地关系为主线，加快补齐农业农村发展短板，为全面建设社会主义现代化国家打下坚实基础。要立足我国生态文明建设已进入以降碳为重点战略方向的关键时期，完善能源消耗总量和强度调控，逐步转向碳排放总量和强度双控制度。要把推动高校教师、科研人员薪酬分配制度改革作为统筹推进教育、科技、人才事业发展的重要抓手，逐步建立激发创新活力、知识价值导向、管理规范有效、保障激励兼顾的薪酬制度，进一步激发高等学校、科研院所创新创造活力。要围绕提升国家油气安全保障能力的目标，针对油气体制存在的突出问题，积极稳妥推进油气行业上、中、下游体制机制改革，确保稳定可靠供应。要深化电力体制改革，加快构建清洁低碳、安全充裕、经济高效、供需协同、灵活智能的新型电力系统，更好推动能源生产和消费革命，保障国家能源安全。中共中央政治局常委、中央全面深化改革委员会副主任李强、王沪宁、蔡奇出席会议。会议指出，当前，我国发展面临复杂严峻的国际形势。要完善开放型经济新体制的顶层设计，深化贸易投资领域体制机制改革，扩大市场准入，全面优化营商环境，完善服务保障体系，充分发挥我国综合优势，以国内大循环吸引全球资源要素，提升贸易投资合作质量和水平。要坚持底线思维、极限思维，抓紧健全国家安全保障体制机制，着力提升开放监管能力和水平。要把构建更高水平开放型经济新体制同高质量共建“一带一路”等国家战略紧密衔接起来，积极参与全球治理体系改革和建设。会议强调，贯彻落实党的二十大对深化农村改革的部署，要着力巩固和完善农村基本经营制度，健全粮食安全保障制度，完善全面推进乡村振兴体制机制，健全城乡融合发展政策体系，加快推动重要领域和关键环节改革攻坚突破、落地见效，让广大农民在改革中有更多获得感。要把顶层设计同基层探索有机结合起来，允许和鼓励不同地区因地制宜探索，善于发现和总结基层的实践创造，对探索创新中遇到困难的要及时给予支持。会议指出，党的十八大以来，我们把绿色低碳和节能减排摆在突出位置，建立并实施能源消耗总量和强度双控制度，有力促进我国能源利用效率大幅提升和二氧化碳排放强度持续下降。从能耗双控逐步转向碳排放双控，要坚持先立后破，完善能耗双控制度，优化完善调控方式，加强碳排放双控基础能力建设，健全碳排放双控各项配套制度，为建立和实施碳排放双控制度积极创造条件。要一以贯之坚持节约优先方针，更高水平、更高质量地做好节能工作，用最小成本实现最大收益。要把稳工作节奏，统筹好发展和减排关系，实事求是、量力而行，科学调整优化政策举措。会议强调，开展高等学校、科研院所薪酬制度改革试点，要根据薪酬管理需要和实际，优化和规范分配制度，树立正确分配导向，坚持人才为本，突出创新优先，坚持薪酬分配要同绩效紧密挂钩，向扎根教学科研一线、承担急难险重任务、作出突出贡献的人员倾斜，向从事基础学科教学和基础前沿研究、承担国家关键核心技术攻关任务、取得重大创新成果的人员倾斜。要加强薪酬管理监督，确保把国家的钱用在人才激励和事业发展最需要的地方。会议指出，要进一步深化石油天然气市场体系改革，加强产供储销体系建设。要加大市场监管力度，强化分领域监管和跨领域协同监管，规范油气市场秩序，促进公平竞争。要深化油气储备体制改革，发挥好储备的应急和调节能力。会议强调，要科学合理设计新型电力系统建设路径，在新能源安全可靠替代的基础上，有计划分步骤逐步降低传统能源比重。要健全适应新型电力系统的体制机制，推动加强电力技术创新、市场机制创新、商业模式创新。要推动有效市场同有为政府更好结合，不断完善政策体系，做好电力基本公共服务供给。中央全面深化改革委员会委员出席会议，中央和国家机关有关部门负责同志列席会议。
display_text_en:
Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the Communist Party of China Central Committee, President of China, Chairman of the Central Military Commission, and Director of the Central Commission for Comprehensively Deepening Reform, chaired the second meeting of the Central Commission for Comprehensively Deepening Reform on the afternoon of July 11. The meeting reviewed and approved the Opinions on Establishing a Higher-Standard Open-Economy System to Promote the Creation of a New Development Pattern, the Implementation Plan for Deepening Rural Reform, the Opinions on Promoting a Gradual Shift from Dual Controls on Energy Consumption to Dual Controls on Carbon Emissions, the Opinions on Piloting Reform of the Remuneration System at Higher-Education Institutions and Research Institutes, the Implementation Opinions on Further Deepening Reform of the Oil and Gas Market System and Enhancing the Country's Capacity to Safeguard Oil and Gas Security, and the Guiding Opinions on Deepening Power-System Reform and Accelerating the Establishment of a New Power System.

While chairing the meeting, Xi Jinping emphasised that establishing a higher-standard open-economy system was a strategic measure taken on China's own initiative to use opening up to promote reform and development. Centred on serving the creation of a new development pattern, emphasis must be placed on institutional opening up; reform of institutions and mechanisms must be deepened in key areas of external exchange and cooperation such as investment, trade, finance, and innovation; supporting policies and measures must be improved; and China's opening up must be raised proactively to a new level. The strategic goals of modernising agriculture and rural areas and building strength in agriculture must be firmly anchored. Properly handling the relationship between farmers and land must be the main thread, weak links in agricultural and rural development must be remedied more rapidly, and a solid foundation must be laid for fully building a modern socialist country. Based on the fact that China's development of an ecological civilisation had entered a critical period in which carbon reduction was the key strategic direction, regulation of the total amount and intensity of energy consumption must be improved and a gradual shift made towards a system of dual controls on the total amount and intensity of carbon emissions. Reform of the remuneration-distribution system for university teachers and research personnel must be treated as an important lever for advancing education, science and technology, and talent in a coordinated manner. A remuneration system that stimulates innovative vitality, is guided by the value of knowledge, has standardised and effective management, and balances safeguards and incentives must be gradually established to further stimulate the innovative and creative vitality of higher-education institutions and research institutes. Centred on the goal of enhancing the country's capacity to safeguard oil and gas security, reforms of institutions and mechanisms in the upstream, midstream, and downstream segments of the oil and gas industry must be advanced actively and prudently in response to prominent problems in the oil and gas system, ensuring a stable and reliable supply. Power-system reform must be deepened and construction of a new power system that is clean and low-carbon, safe and sufficient, economical and efficient, coordinated between supply and demand, flexible, and intelligent must be accelerated, to better promote the transformation of energy production and consumption and safeguard national energy security.

Li Qiang, Wang Huning, and Cai Qi, members of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Deputy Directors of the Central Commission for Comprehensively Deepening Reform, attended the meeting.

The meeting stated that China's development currently faced a complex and severe international situation. The top-level design of the new open-economy system must be improved, reform of institutions and mechanisms in trade and investment deepened, market access expanded, the business environment comprehensively optimised, and service and safeguard systems improved. China's combined strengths must be brought fully into play, the domestic economic cycle used to attract global resources and factors of production, and the quality and level of trade and investment cooperation raised. Bottom-line and worst-case thinking must be upheld, the institutions and mechanisms safeguarding national security improved promptly, and capacity and standards for supervising opening up raised with a focus. Establishing a higher-standard open-economy system must be closely linked with national strategies such as high-quality joint construction of the Belt and Road, and China must actively participate in reform and development of the global governance system.

The meeting emphasised that, in implementing the arrangements made by the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China for deepening rural reform, efforts must focus on consolidating and improving the basic rural-management system, strengthening the food-security safeguard system, improving institutions and mechanisms for comprehensively advancing rural revitalisation, and improving the policy system for integrated urban-rural development. Breakthroughs and effective implementation of reforms in important areas and key links must be accelerated, giving farmers a greater sense of benefit from reform. Top-level design must be organically combined with grassroots exploration. Different regions must be permitted and encouraged to explore in light of local conditions, and there must be skill in identifying and summarising practical innovations at the grassroots level, with timely support provided when difficulties are encountered during exploration and innovation.

The meeting stated that, since the 18th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, green and low-carbon development, energy conservation, and emissions reduction had been given a prominent position. A system of dual controls on the total amount and intensity of energy consumption had been established and implemented, strongly promoting substantial improvement in China's energy-use efficiency and a continued decline in carbon-dioxide emissions intensity. In gradually shifting from dual controls on energy consumption to dual controls on carbon emissions, new systems must be established before old ones are abolished; the dual-control system for energy consumption must be improved; methods of regulation optimised and improved; foundational capacity for dual controls on carbon emissions strengthened; and the various supporting institutions for dual controls on carbon emissions improved, actively creating conditions for establishing and implementing a dual-control system for carbon emissions. The principle of prioritising conservation must be upheld consistently, energy conservation must be carried out to higher standards and with higher quality, and maximum benefits achieved at minimum cost. The pace of work must be kept steady, the relationship between development and emissions reduction coordinated, facts respected and actions kept within capabilities, and policy measures adjusted and optimised scientifically.

The meeting emphasised that, in conducting pilots of remuneration-system reform at higher-education institutions and research institutes, the distribution system must be optimised and standardised in line with remuneration-management needs and actual conditions, and the correct orientation for distribution established. A people-centred approach must be upheld, innovation given priority, and remuneration distribution closely linked to performance. Remuneration must be weighted towards personnel rooted on the front lines of teaching and research, undertaking difficult, urgent, dangerous, and important tasks, and making outstanding contributions; and towards those engaged in teaching basic disciplines and basic and frontier research, undertaking national tasks to achieve breakthroughs in key core technologies, and attaining major innovative achievements. Supervision of remuneration management must be strengthened to ensure that state funds are used where they are most needed for talent incentives and development of the relevant undertakings.

The meeting stated that reform of the oil and gas market system must be deepened further and systems for production, supply, storage, and sales strengthened. Market supervision must be intensified, sector-specific supervision and coordinated cross-sector supervision strengthened, order in the oil and gas market standardised, and fair competition promoted. Reform of the oil and gas reserve system must be deepened, and the emergency-response and regulatory capacities of reserves brought fully into play.

The meeting emphasised that the path for constructing the new power system must be designed scientifically and rationally, and that the share of traditional energy must be reduced gradually, in a planned and step-by-step manner, on the basis of safe and reliable substitution by new energy. Institutions and mechanisms suited to the new power system must be improved, and stronger innovation in power technology, market mechanisms, and business models promoted. Effective markets and a well-functioning government must be better combined, the policy system continuously improved, and the provision of basic public power services ensured.

Members of the Central Commission for Comprehensively Deepening Reform attended the meeting, and responsible officials from relevant central Party and state departments were present as non-voting participants.

display_text_en: On June 15, the central bank announced that it would conduct a RMB 237 billion medium-term lending facility (MLF) operation and a RMB 2 billion open-market reverse-repurchase operation to maintain reasonably ample liquidity in the banking system. The winning bid rate on the one-year MLF was 2.65%, down from the previous 2.75%, while the winning bid rate on the seven-day reverse-repurchase operation remained at 1.9%.

source_text_zh: 6月29日，国务院发布《关于在有条件的自由贸易试验区和自由贸易港试点对接国际高标准推进制度型开放的若干措施》，提出33条具体措施，旨在推动货物和服务贸易、便利商务人员入境、促进数字贸易、优化营商环境及完善风险防控等。这些措施将首先在上海、广东、天津、福建、北京等自贸区以及海南自由贸易港实施。此次政策强化了内外资金融机构的平等待遇，并简化了航空器和船舶的关税政策，预计将提升外国投资者信心，鼓励外商投资并降低国际贸易成本。
display_text_en: On June 29, the State Council issued the Measures for Advancing Institutional Opening Up by Aligning with High-Standard International Economic and Trade Rules in Eligible Pilot Free Trade Zones and Free Trade Ports, proposing 33 specific measures intended to promote trade in goods and services, facilitate the entry of business personnel, promote digital trade, optimise the business environment, and improve risk prevention and control, among other aims. These measures would first be implemented in pilot free trade zones including Shanghai, Guangdong, Tianjin, Fujian, and Beijing, as well as in the Hainan Free Trade Port. The policy strengthened equal treatment of Chinese-funded and foreign-funded financial institutions and simplified tariff policies for aircraft and vessels. It was expected to strengthen foreign-investor confidence, encourage foreign investment, and reduce international trade costs.

source_text_zh: 2023年6月20日，中国央行再次下调1年期和5年期以上的贷款市场报价利率（LPR），分别为3.55%和4.2%，均较上月下调10个基点。此举是因中期借贷便利（MLF）利率的下降，旨在增强逆周期调节能力以支持经济增长。专家指出，LPR下调将降低实体经济融资成本，促进信贷需求，提振市场信心，并可能刺激消费和房地产市场的发展。同时，这一政策反映了货币政策的精准性，有助于稳定市场预期。
display_text_en: On June 20, 2023, the People's Bank of China again lowered the one-year loan prime rate (LPR) and the LPR for terms of more than five years, to 3.55% and 4.2%, respectively, both down 10 basis points from the previous month. The move followed a decline in the medium-term lending facility (MLF) rate and was intended to strengthen countercyclical adjustment in support of economic growth. Experts noted that lower LPRs would reduce financing costs in the real economy, promote credit demand, bolster market confidence, and might stimulate development of the consumption and property markets. At the same time, the policy reflected the precision of monetary policy and would help stabilise market expectations.
